看来.en: It looks like it's going to rain today.

看来.zh: 看来他已经知道这件事了。
看来.en: It seems he already knows about this.

看来.zh: 既然大家都来了，看来会议可以开始了。
看来.en: Since everyone is here, it seems the meeting can start.

看来.zh: 从你的表情看来，你好像不太高兴。
看来.en: From your expression, it seems you're not very happy.

酒.en: He drank a lot of alcohol.
This bottle of wine is too expensive.
He blushes every time he drinks alcohol.

酒.zh: 虽然我不喜欢喝酒，但今天破例喝了一杯。
酒.en: Although I don't like drinking, today I made an exception and had a glass.

酒.zh: 我们买了一些酒带回家。
酒.en: We bought some wine to bring home.

欢迎.en: Everyone is welcome to come to the party.

欢迎.zh: 如果你愿意，我们随时欢迎你。
欢迎.en: If you want, you are always welcome here.

欢迎.zh: 这家店欢迎顾客提意见。

一般.en: I usually get up at seven.

一般.zh: 虽然成绩一般，但他很努力。
一般.en: Although his grades are average, he works very hard.

一般.zh: 这种问题一般不难解决。
一般.en: This kind of problem is generally not hard to solve.

可爱.en: That little girl is really cute.

可爱.zh: 因为小狗太可爱了，大家都想抱它。
可爱.en: Because the puppy is so cute, everyone wants to hold it.

可爱.zh: 他送给我一个可爱的小熊。
可爱.en: He gave me a cute little bear.

新闻.zh: 我看新闻说明天要下雨。
新闻.en: I saw the news saying it will rain tomorrow.

新闻.zh: 虽然新闻不准确，但我还是信了。
新闻.en: Although the news is not accurate, I still believed it.

新闻.zh: 他每天都在手机上看新闻。
新闻.en: He watches news on his phone every day.

新闻.zh: 这条新闻是关于地震的。
新闻.en: This news is about the earthquake.

怎样.en: How did you know about this?

怎样.zh: 如果你不知道怎样做，就问老师。
怎样.en: If you don't know how to do it, ask the teacher.
How do we get to the station?

金.zh: 她戴了一条金项链，很好看。
金.en: She wears a gold necklace, very beautiful.

金.zh: 因为是金的，所以价格很高。
金.en: Because it's gold, the price is high.
Goldfish swim around in the water.

收.zh: 我昨天收到了一份礼物。

收.en: If you don't take it, I'll throw it away.

声音.en: I like to hear the sound of birds.

声音.zh: 虽然声音很小，但我还是听到了。
声音.en: Although the sound is very quiet, I still heard it.
The voice on the phone is not clear.

马上.zh: 电影马上开始了，我们快进去。
马上.en: The movie is about to start, let's go in quickly.

马上.zh: 如果你马上出发，还来得及。
马上.en: If you leave immediately, you can still make it.

马上.zh: 他马上要考试了，很紧张。
马上.en: He is about to take an exam, very nervous.

变成.zh: 几年不见，他变成了一个大人。
变成.en: Haven't seen him for years, he has become an adult.

变成.zh: 因为努力，她变成了优秀的学生。
变成.en: Because of hard work, she became an excellent student.
The caterpillar turned into a butterfly.

变成.zh: 我们的计划变成了现实。

受到.zh: 她的行为受到了大家的批评。
受到.en: Her behavior was criticized by everyone.

受到.zh: 虽然受到了很多困难，但他没有放弃。
受到.en: Although he encountered many difficulties, he didn't give up.

受到.zh: 这家公司受到了顾客的欢迎。
受到.en: This company is welcomed by customers.

发展.zh: 中国的经济一直在快速发展。
发展.en: China's economy has been developing rapidly.

发展.zh: 随着科技的发展，生活越来越方便。
发展.en: With the development of technology, life becomes more convenient.

发展.zh: 公司需要新的发展计划。
发展.en: The company needs a new development plan.
This area is developing very fast.

经过.zh: 经过讨论，我们决定去海边。
经过.en: After discussion, we decided to go to the beach.

经过.zh: 经过他的帮助，我完成了任务。
经过.en: With his help, I completed the task.

经过.zh: 经过这次旅行，我学到了很多。
经过.en: Through this trip, I learned a lot.

经过.zh: 经过长时间的等待，他终于来了。
经过.en: After a long wait, he finally came.

只能.en: I can only eat one bowl of rice.

只能.zh: 因为下雨，我们只能待在家里。
只能.en: Because it's raining, we can only stay home.

只能.zh: 对不起，我只能帮你这么多。
只能.en: Sorry, I can only help you this much.

只能.zh: 这里没有别的选择，你只能同意了。
只能.en: There's no other choice here, you have to agree.

只能.zh: 我只能说，这件事很难办。
只能.en: I can only say, this matter is hard to handle.

历史.zh: 这个城市有很长的历史。
历史.en: This city has a long history.

历史.zh: 虽然历史很重要，但我更喜欢科学。
历史.en: Although history is important, I prefer science.

哭.zh: 她看了一部很感人的电影，哭了。
哭.en: She watched a touching movie and cried.
Children cry as soon as they fall.

哭.zh: 如果你不舒服，就哭出来吧。
哭.en: If you feel uncomfortable, just cry it out.

汽车.zh: 我每天早上坐汽车上班。
汽车.en: I take a car to work every morning.

汽车.zh: 因为堵车，汽车开得很慢。
汽车.en: Because of traffic, the car is going very slowly.

汽车.zh: 他买了一辆新的汽车，颜色是红色的。
汽车.en: He bought a new car, and its color is red.

怕.en: Don't be afraid, I will protect you.
She's afraid of doing poorly on the exam.
Many people are afraid of flying.

怕.zh: 我怕他生气，所以没敢说。
怕.en: I was afraid he would be angry, so I didn't dare say it.

会议.en: There is a meeting this afternoon.

会议.zh: 会议明天早上九点开始。
这个会议很重要，你一定要参加。
会议.en: This meeting is very important; you must attend.

会议.zh: 刚才的会议讨论了新项目。
会议.en: The meeting just now discussed the new project.

会议.zh: 因为老板不在，会议取消了。
会议.en: Because the boss is not here, the meeting was cancelled.

试.zh: 我想试试看能不能做到。
试.en: I want to try and see if I can do it.

试.zh: 这双鞋很舒服，你要不要试试？
试.en: These shoes are very comfortable, do you want to try them?

试.zh: 试了以后，我觉得不太好。
试.en: After trying, I felt it's not very good.

试.zh: 他试了很多次，终于成功了。
试.en: He tried many times, and finally succeeded.

面前.en: Who is the person standing in front of me?

面前.zh: 困难面前，我们不能放弃。
面前.en: In the face of difficulties, we cannot give up.

面前.zh: 他把礼物放在我的面前。
面前.en: He placed the gift in front of me.

面前.zh: 在事实面前，他终于承认了。
面前.en: In the face of facts, he finally admitted.

面前.zh: 机会就在你面前，要抓住它。
面前.en: Opportunity is right in front of you; you have to seize it.

节目.zh: 你最喜欢哪个电视节目？
节目.en: Which TV program do you like best?

节目.zh: 我经常在电脑上看综艺节目。
节目.en: I often watch variety shows on the computer.

节目.zh: 因为广告太多，我不太想看这个节目。
节目.en: Because there are too many ads, I don't really want to watch this program.

健康.en: For health, I run every day.

健康.zh: 健康的饮食对身体有益。
健康.en: A healthy diet is good for the body.
Recently his health is not very good.

西.en: Just head west and you'll get there.
A new store opened in the west.

西.zh: 我向西走了十分钟才到车站。
西.en: I walked west for ten minutes before reaching the station.

西.zh: 虽然西边下雨，但东边是晴天。
西.en: Although it's raining in the west, it's sunny in the east.

西.zh: 他家住城西，离公司很远。
西.en: His home is in the west of the city, far from the company.

差.en: This phone's quality is very poor.

差.zh: 我差你五块钱，明天一定还给你。
差.en: I owe you five yuan, I'll definitely give it back tomorrow.

差.zh: 因为天气差，所以我们没去公园。
差.en: Because the weather was bad, we didn't go to the park.
His grades are poor but he works hard.

结婚.en: They will get married next month.
My older sister is getting married this year.

结婚.zh: 结婚后他们一起去日本旅行。
结婚.en: After getting married, they traveled to Japan together.

结婚.zh: 他还没结婚，但已经有女朋友了。
结婚.en: He's not married yet, but he already has a girlfriend.

结婚.zh: 虽然他们认识不久，但还是决定结婚。
结婚.en: Although they haven't known each other long, they still decided to get married.

身边.en: I don't have any change on me.
She always has friends around her.

身边.zh: 他身边总是带着一只白色小狗。
身边.en: He always carries a small white dog with him.

身边.zh: 虽然工作忙，但我希望家人能在身边。
身边.en: Although work is busy, I hope my family can be by my side.

身边.zh: 只要你在我身边，我就安心了。
身边.en: As long as you're by my side, I feel at ease.

短.en: His hair has been cut much shorter.

短.zh: 因为时间短，我们只逛了两个景点。
短.en: Because time was short, we only visited two scenic spots.

短.zh: 这部电影很短，只有一小时而已。
短.en: This movie is very short, only one hour.

同意.zh: 老板同意了我的假期申请。
同意.en: The boss approved my leave application.

同意.zh: 大家都同意这个计划吗？
同意.en: Does everyone agree with this plan?

同意.zh: 他不同意我的看法，但没说什么。
同意.en: He didn't agree with my view, but he didn't say anything.

同意.zh: 虽然妈妈不同意，我还是决定去。
同意.en: Although Mom disagreed, I still decided to go.

几乎.zh: 因为下雨，所以几乎没人来上课。
几乎.en: Because it was raining, almost no one came to class.

几乎.zh: 我几乎忘了今天是你的生日。
几乎.en: I almost forgot that today is your birthday.

查.zh: 她在网上查了很多资料。
查.en: She looked up a lot of information online.

查.zh: 因为丢了钱包，我去警察局查了监控。
查.en: Because I lost my wallet, I went to the police station to check the surveillance footage.

查.zh: 他查了天气预报，结果说明天有雨。
查.en: He checked the weather forecast, and it said it will rain tomorrow.

不用.en: You don't have to be polite.
I don't have to go to work today.

不用.zh: 今天不用带伞，因为不会下雨。
不用.en: You don't need to bring an umbrella today because it won't rain.

不用.zh: 既然你不喜欢，那就不用买了。
不用.en: Since you don't like it, then don't buy it.

附近.zh: 他在附近找了半天也没找到。
附近.en: He searched nearby for a long time but didn't find it.

附近.zh: 因为附近没有超市，我们去了远一点的。
附近.en: Because there's no supermarket nearby, we went to a farther one.

认真.zh: 你做事要认真，不要马虎。
认真.en: You must be serious when doing things, don't be careless.

认真.zh: 虽然很累，但他还是认真完成了工作。
认真.en: Although very tired, he still finished the work seriously.
The teacher told us to listen carefully.

脚.zh: 走路的时候小心别扭到脚。
脚.en: When walking, be careful not to sprain your foot.
She wears a pair of red shoes on her feet.

脚.zh: 昨天爬山，我的脚都磨出泡了。
脚.en: Yesterday climbing the mountain, my feet got blisters.

脚.zh: 他踢足球的时候不小心踢到了我的脚。
脚.en: He accidentally kicked my foot while playing soccer.

电.en: Remember to turn off the electricity before leaving.
This month's electricity bill is high.

电.zh: 手机没电了，我得找个插座。
电.en: My phone is out of battery, I need to find an outlet.

电.zh: 晚上用电高峰，电压不太稳定。
电.en: During the evening peak electricity usage, voltage is not very stable.

房子.zh: 他们刚买了一套新房子。
房子.en: They just bought a new house.

房子.zh: 因为房价太贵，他现在还租房子住。
房子.en: Because housing prices are too expensive, he still rents a place.

房子.zh: 这房子虽然旧，但位置很好。
房子.en: Although this house is old, the location is good.

山.en: There are many trees on the mountain.

山.zh: 从山顶看下去，风景特别美。
山.en: Looking down from the mountain top, the scenery is especially beautiful.

山.zh: 他们住在山脚下的小村子里。
山.en: They live in a small village at the foot of the mountain.

主要.zh: 这次会议的主要目的是讨论预算。
主要.en: The main purpose of this meeting is to discuss the budget.
He is mainly responsible for customer service.

主要.zh: 我们今天主要聊聊下个季度的计划。
主要.en: Today we mainly talk about next quarter's plans.

主要.zh: 导致失败的主要原因是准备不足。
主要.en: The main reason for the failure was insufficient preparation.

市.zh: 明天我要去市里办点事。
市.en: Tomorrow I need to go to the city center to handle some matters.
I like going to the supermarket.
The transportation in this city is very convenient.

市.zh: 蔬菜市的价格比超市便宜。
市.en: The prices at the vegetable market are cheaper than the supermarket.

比如.en: For example, this apple is delicious.

比如.zh: 很多水果，比如苹果和香蕉，我都喜欢。
比如.en: Many fruits, for example apples and bananas, I all like.

比如.zh: 比如周末，我们可以去游泳。
比如.en: For example, on weekends, we can go swimming.

比如.zh: 他有很多爱好，比如打篮球、听音乐。
比如.en: He has many hobbies, for example playing basketball, listening to music.

比如.zh: 如果你想吃辣的，比如火锅，就去那家店。
比如.en: If you want to eat spicy food, for example hotpot, go to that restaurant.

后来.zh: 开始我不喜欢，后来慢慢就习惯了。
后来.en: At first I didn't like it, later I gradually got used to it.

后来.zh: 我们后来去了公园，玩得很开心。
后来.en: Later we went to the park and had a great time.

后来.zh: 他先拒绝了，但后来又答应了。
后来.en: He first refused, but later agreed.

常.en: I often go to that store.
He often works overtime until very late.

常.zh: 因为工作忙，我常忘记吃午饭。
常.en: Because work is busy, I often forget to eat lunch.

嘴.en: Your mouth is really sweet (you say nice things).

嘴.zh: 他嘴里含着糖，说话不清楚。
嘴.en: He has candy in his mouth, so his speech is unclear.

嘴.zh: 别多嘴，这件事不关你的事。
嘴.en: Don't be nosy, this matter doesn't concern you.

嘴.zh: 虽然她嘴上说没事，但其实心里很难过。
嘴.en: Although she says it's okay with her mouth, actually she is very sad inside.
My mouth is very dry, I want to drink water.

遇到.en: I met him on the road.

遇到.zh: 如果你遇到困难，一定要告诉我。
遇到.en: If you encounter difficulties, be sure to tell me.

遇到.zh: 今天遇到老朋友，很开心。
遇到.en: Today I met an old friend, very happy.

遇到.zh: 因为经常遇到堵车，所以我改坐地铁了。
遇到.en: Because I often encounter traffic jams, I switched to taking the subway.

遇到.zh: 她在旅行中遇到了很多有意思的人。
遇到.en: She met many interesting people during the trip.

海.zh: 夏天的时候，很多人去海边游泳。
海.en: In summer, many people go to the seaside to swim.

海.zh: 虽然我没见过海，但我很想去。
海.en: Although I haven't seen the sea, I really want to go.

海.zh: 那片海非常安静，让人心情放松。
海.en: That sea is very quiet, making people feel relaxed.

跳.en: The puppy is happily jumping around.
Don't jump, be careful not to fall.

跳.zh: 因为太兴奋了，她忍不住跳了起来。
跳.en: Because she was too excited, she couldn't help jumping up.
He jumped into the water from the bridge.

回答.en: His answer made me very satisfied.

回答.zh: 老师问的问题，没人能回答。
回答.en: No one could answer the teacher's question.

回答.zh: 如果你不知道答案，就说不知道，不要乱回答。
回答.en: If you don't know the answer, say you don't know, don't answer randomly.
She thought for a long time before answering.

年轻.zh: 年轻的时候要多学点东西。
年轻.en: When young, you should learn more things.
He is two years younger than me.

年轻.zh: 虽然他已经四十岁了，但心态还是很年轻。
年轻.en: Although he is forty years old, his mentality is still young.

年轻.zh: 年轻人不喜欢做这种无聊的工作。
年轻.en: Young people don't like doing this kind of boring work.

久.en: We haven't seen each other for a long time.

久.zh: 因为很久没运动，所以他跑了一会儿就累了。
久.en: Because he hasn't exercised for a long time, he got tired after running for a while.

久.zh: 她离开家很久了，很想回去。
久.en: She left home a long time ago, and really wants to go back.

记.en: I can't remember your phone number.

记.zh: 你把这件事记在笔记本上吧。
记.en: Write this down in the notebook.
He has a good memory, never forgets.

记.zh: 虽然我记不清细节了，但大概还记得。
记.en: Although I can't remember the details clearly, I still roughly remember.

记.zh: 别担心，我会记着给你买礼物。
记.en: Don't worry, I'll remember to buy you a gift.

关注.zh: 这件事引起了很多人的关注。
关注.en: This matter attracted a lot of people's attention.

关注.zh: 他最近很关注健康问题。
关注.en: He has been paying a lot of attention to health issues recently.

关注.zh: 如果你关注新闻，就知道这件事了。
关注.en: If you pay attention to the news, you would know about this.

关注.zh: 社交媒体上大家都在关注这个话题。
关注.en: Everyone on social media is paying attention to this topic.

表演.en: There is a performance at school tomorrow.

表演.zh: 因为排练了很久，所以表演非常成功。
表演.en: Because they rehearsed for a long time, the performance was very successful.

表演.zh: 孩子们在台上表演唱歌跳舞。
表演.en: The children performed singing and dancing on stage.

关.en: Did you turn off the light?
This matter has nothing to do with me.

关.zh: 别忘了关窗，外面要下雨了。
关.en: Don't forget to close the window; it's going to rain outside.
He turned off the computer and left.

牛.en: Cows eat grass, and we drink milk.
She actually got a perfect score, so impressive!

刚才.en: Someone was looking for you just now.

刚才.zh: 刚才天气还好好的，现在下雨了。
刚才.en: The weather was fine just now, but now it's raining.

刚才.zh: 你刚才说的话我没听清楚。
刚才.en: I didn't hear clearly what you said just now.

风.en: It's windy outside, is it cold?
The wind blowing over feels very pleasant.

风.zh: 因为风太大，我们没去海边。
风.en: Because the wind was too strong, we didn't go to the beach.
The wind blew all the leaves off the trees.

办公室.en: He went to the office to get the documents.

办公室.zh: 我们办公室新来了一个同事。
办公室.en: A new colleague came to our office.

办公室.zh: 等办公室没人了，我们再聊。
办公室.en: Let's talk when the office is empty.

照.zh: 照着这个方向走就到了。
照.en: Follow this direction and you'll arrive.

照.zh: 我照你说的做了，但是没用。
照.en: I did as you said, but it didn't work.

环境.zh: 这个办公室环境很舒服。
环境.en: The office environment is very comfortable.

环境.zh: 环境对孩子成长很重要。
环境.en: The environment is very important for a child's growth.

环境.zh: 虽然工作很忙，但环境很好。
环境.en: Although work is busy, the environment is good.

收到.en: The gift has been received, thank you!

收到.zh: 刚刚收到通知，明天开会。
收到.en: Just received a notice that there's a meeting tomorrow.

收到.zh: 我收到了很多生日祝福。

方向.en: You're going in the wrong direction.

方向.zh: 我不太确定方向，得查一下地图。
方向.en: I'm not sure about the direction; I need to check the map.

关心.en: My mom cares about me a lot.
Do you care about this matter?
Thanks for your concern, I'm fine.

关心.zh: 虽然不常联系，但他一直关心我。
关心.en: Although we don't often contact, he always cares about me.

节.en: There is a music festival this weekend.

节.zh: 圣诞节我们全家一起吃饭。
节.en: We have a family dinner together on Christmas.

节.zh: 他每天都会看一节网课。
节.en: He watches one online lesson every day.

节.zh: 春天是旅游的好季节，所以我想去爬山。
节.en: Spring is a good season for travel, so I want to go hiking.

节.zh: 你记得节约用水，别浪费。
节.en: Remember to save water, don't waste it.

层.en: She lives three floors above my home.

层.zh: 蛋糕上有一层厚厚的奶油。
层.en: There is a thick layer of cream on the cake.

层.zh: 虽然天气很冷，但她只穿了一层薄外套。
层.en: Although it's very cold, she only wore a thin layer of coat.

层.zh: 这件事需要从不同层面去考虑。
层.en: This matter needs to be considered from different levels.

病人.zh: 医生正在给病人检查身体。
病人.en: The doctor is examining the patient.

病人.zh: 病人吃了药以后感觉好多了。
病人.en: The patient felt much better after taking the medicine.

病人.zh: 每天都有很多病人在医院排队挂号。
病人.en: Every day many patients line up to register at the hospital.

病人.zh: 她是个很耐心的护士，对病人特别温柔。
病人.en: She is a very patient nurse, especially gentle with patients.

心里.zh: 这句话我一直记在心里。
心里.en: I have always kept these words in my heart.

心里.zh: 每次考试前他都会心里紧张。
心里.en: He gets nervous inside before every exam.

心里.zh: 其实她心里明白，只是不想说出来。
心里.en: Actually, she knows it in her heart, but she just doesn't want to say it.

心里.zh: 看到你开心，我心里也特别高兴。
心里.en: Seeing you happy makes me feel really happy inside too.

腿.zh: 他跑步的时候把腿摔伤了。
腿.en: He hurt his leg while running.

腿.zh: 这张桌子有一条腿是坏的。
腿.en: One leg of this table is broken.

腿.zh: 坐久了要站起来活动一下腿。
腿.en: After sitting for a long time, you should stand up and move your legs.

腿.zh: 她穿着短裤，两条腿晒得黑黑的。
腿.en: She was wearing shorts, and both her legs were tanned dark.

街.en: I like to take a walk on the street.

街.zh: 街对面新开了一家奶茶店。
街.en: A new milk tea shop opened across the street.

街.zh: 周末我们一起去逛街买东西吧。
街.en: Let's go shopping on the street this weekend.

街.zh: 街上人太多了，我们换个地方吃晚饭吧。
街.en: There are too many people on the street, let's go somewhere else for dinner.

一边.zh: 她一边吃饭一边看电视。
我一边走路一边听音乐。
一边.en: I listen to music while walking.

一边.zh: 他一边工作一边学习英语，很努力。
一边.en: He works and studies English at the same time, very hardworking.

一边.zh: 一边是山一边是海，风景特别美。
一边.en: On one side is the mountain and on the other side is the sea, the scenery is especially beautiful.

一边.zh: 别一边玩手机一边写作业，容易分心。
一边.en: Don't play on your phone while doing homework, it's easy to get distracted.

鞋.en: My shoes are a bit tight on my feet.

鞋.zh: 他买了一双新运动鞋去跑步。
鞋.en: He bought a new pair of sneakers for running.

鞋.zh: 下雨天出门记得穿雨鞋。
鞋.en: Remember to wear rain boots when going out on rainy days.

鞋.zh: 她把鞋脱在门口，然后进了屋子。
鞋.en: She took off her shoes at the door and then went inside.

习惯.en: I am used to going to bed early and waking up early.
This habit is hard to change.

习惯.zh: 他习惯每天喝一杯咖啡。
习惯.en: He is used to drinking a cup of coffee every day.

习惯.zh: 来中国以后，我慢慢习惯了吃辣。
习惯.en: After coming to China, I gradually got used to eating spicy food.

习惯.zh: 虽然换了新环境，但我很快就习惯了这里的生活。
习惯.en: Although I changed to a new environment, I quickly got used to life here.

变化.zh: 几年没见，她的变化太大了。
变化.en: I haven't seen her for a few years, she has changed a lot.

变化.zh: 随着时间的变化，我们的想法也会不同。
变化.en: As time changes, our thoughts will also be different.

变化.zh: 社会在不断变化，我们要学会适应。
变化.en: Society is constantly changing, we need to learn to adapt.

周末.en: What are you planning to do this weekend?

周末.zh: 我周末通常在家休息或者和朋友出去吃饭。
周末.en: I usually rest at home or go out to eat with friends on weekends.

周末.zh: 这个周末我们要去爬山，你要不要一起？
周末.en: We're going hiking this weekend, do you want to join?

周末.zh: 因为周末人太多，所以我们决定去远一点的地方玩。
周末.en: Because there are too many people on weekends, we decided to go to a farther place to play.

听说.zh: 我听说那家新开的餐厅味道很不错。
听说.en: I heard that newly opened restaurant tastes very good.

听说.zh: 虽然听说很难，但我还是想试试。
听说.en: Although I heard it's difficult, I still want to try.

听说.zh: 听说最近有台风，出门要注意安全。
听说.en: I heard there's a typhoon recently, be careful when going out.

直到.zh: 他直到晚上十点才做完作业。
直到.en: He didn't finish his homework until 10 p.m.

直到.zh: 因为堵车，直到下午三点我们才到机场。
直到.en: Because of traffic jam, we didn't arrive at the airport until 3 p.m.

直到.zh: 直到最后他也没有放弃。
直到.en: Until the end, he never gave up.

毛.en: This cat's fur is very soft.
This sweater is made of pure wool.
He has a lot of body hair.

毛.zh: 如果你对动物的毛过敏，就要小心养宠物。
毛.en: If you are allergic to animal fur, you need to be careful about keeping pets.
He shaved the hair on his legs.

忘记.en: I forgot to bring the keys.

忘记.zh: 她总是忘记关灯，真拿她没办法。
忘记.en: She always forgets to turn off the lights, really can't help her.

忘记.zh: 因为太忙，我忘记给妈妈打电话了。
忘记.en: Because too busy, I forgot to call mom.

忘记.zh: 你忘记我们昨天约好的事情了吗？
忘记.en: Did you forget what we agreed on yesterday?

船.zh: 这艘船可以坐两百个人。
船.en: This ship can hold two hundred people.
There are many boats on the sea.

船.zh: 因为风浪很大，船今天不开。
船.en: Because the wind and waves are big, the boat won't sail today.
He goes to work by boat every day.

养.zh: 她养了很多花，都开得很好。
养.en: She grows many flowers, all blooming well.

养.zh: 虽然养猫很麻烦，但我还是很喜欢。
养.en: Although keeping cats is troublesome, I still like it.
He makes money by raising pigs.

鸡.en: The chicken crowed, get up quickly.

鸡.zh: 今天中午我们吃烤鸡好不好？
鸡.en: Shall we have roast chicken for lunch today?
The chicken runs in the yard.

鸡.zh: 因为鸡生病了，所以今天没有鸡蛋吃。
鸡.en: Because the chickens are sick, there are no eggs to eat today.
He feeds the chickens twice a day.

遍.zh: 这篇文章我读了三遍才懂。
遍.en: I read this article three times to understand.
He traveled all over the world.

遍.zh: 虽然我已经说了一遍，但你还是没听懂。
遍.en: Although I said it once, you still didn't understand.

遍.zh: 请再说一遍，我没听清楚。
遍.en: Please say it again, I didn't hear clearly.

打算.en: When do you plan to leave?

打算.zh: 我打算明年去日本留学。
打算.en: I plan to study abroad in Japan next year.
I plan to buy a car.

打算.zh: 如果天气好，我们打算去海边玩。
打算.en: If the weather is good, we plan to go to the beach.

打算.zh: 你打算怎么解决这个问题？
打算.en: How do you plan to solve this problem?

室.en: The meeting room is on the third floor.

室.zh: 他在卧室里睡觉，别吵他。
室.en: He's sleeping in the bedroom, don't disturb him.

室.zh: 教室的灯坏了，我们得去换一个。
室.en: The light in the classroom is broken, we need to replace it.

室.zh: 虽然办公室很小，但是布置得很温馨。
室.en: Although the office is very small, it is decorated very warmly.

哈哈.en: He laughed heartily after hearing the joke.

哈哈.zh: 她一边看喜剧一边哈哈笑个不停。
哈哈.en: She kept laughing while watching the comedy.

哈哈.zh: 哈哈，这个问题太简单了，我早就知道了。
哈哈.en: Haha, this question is too easy, I knew it a long time ago.

极.zh: 他跑得极快，没人追得上。
极.en: He runs extremely fast, no one can catch up.

极.zh: 天气热极了，我们别出门了。
极.en: The weather is extremely hot, let's not go out.

极.zh: 这部电影极无聊，我看到一半就睡着了。
极.en: This movie is extremely boring, I fell asleep halfway through.

极.zh: 她不但聪明极了，而且非常努力。
极.en: She is not only extremely smart, but also very hardworking.

咱们.zh: 这件事咱们得好好商量一下。
咱们.en: We need to discuss this matter carefully.

咱们.zh: 咱们是好朋友，不用客气。
咱们.en: We are good friends, no need to be polite.

咱们.zh: 如果咱们早点出发，就不会迟到了。
咱们.en: If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have been late.

小心.zh: 小心别摔倒了，地上很滑。
小心.en: Be careful not to fall, the floor is very slippery.

小心.zh: 过马路小心车辆，不要闯红灯。
小心.en: Be careful of cars when crossing the road, don't run the red light.

小心.zh: 他提醒我小心那个坏人，别上当。
小心.en: He reminded me to be careful of that bad guy and not be fooled.

怎么办.en: I have no money left, what should I do?
I lost my keys, what should I do?

怎么办.zh: 明天要考试，我还没复习，怎么办？
怎么办.en: Tomorrow is the exam, I haven't reviewed yet, what should I do?

怎么办.zh: 手机坏了，又没带现金，这可怎么办？
怎么办.en: My phone is broken and I have no cash, what can I do?

动物.zh: 动物园里有很多不同的动物。
动物.en: There are many different animals in the zoo.

动物.zh: 有些动物会冬眠，比如熊和蛇。
动物.en: Some animals hibernate, like bears and snakes.

动物.zh: 他从小就喜欢研究动物，现在当了动物学家。
动物.en: He has loved studying animals since childhood, and now he is a zoologist.

不行.zh: 你的方法不行，再试试别的。
不行.en: Your method doesn't work, try another one.

不行.zh: 我觉得这个计划不行，风险太大了。
不行.en: I think this plan is no good, the risk is too big.

不行.zh: 他身体不行了，得赶紧去医院。
不行.en: His health is failing, he needs to go to the hospital quickly.

饿.en: You're hungry, right? Let's go eat.

饿.zh: 中午没吃饭，现在饿得不行了。
饿.en: I didn't eat lunch, now I'm extremely hungry.

饿.zh: 要是饿了，冰箱里有面包和牛奶。
饿.en: If you're hungry, there's bread and milk in the fridge.

树.en: There are many big trees by the roadside.

树.zh: 夏天的时候，我们喜欢在树下乘凉。
树.en: In summer, we like to cool off under the tree.

树.zh: 这棵树已经活了上百年了。
树.en: This tree has lived for over a hundred years.

树.zh: 秋天到了，树上的叶子都变黄了。
树.en: Autumn has arrived, the leaves on the trees have all turned yellow.

水平.en: His Chinese level is very high.

水平.zh: 这次考试的水平比上次难。
水平.en: The level of this exam is harder than last time.

水平.zh: 我觉得自己的英语水平还需要提高。
水平.en: I think my English level still needs improvement.

水平.zh: 因为平时练习不够，他的水平一直上不去。
水平.en: Because he doesn't practice enough, his level hasn't improved.

水平.zh: 虽然大家都说难，但他的水平完全可以应付。
水平.en: Although everyone says it's difficult, his level is completely up to the task.

借.en: Can you lend me a pen?
He lent me a hundred yuan.

借.zh: 这本书是我从图书馆借的。
借.en: This book is borrowed from the library.

借.zh: 我想跟你借一下你的车，可以吗？
借.en: I want to borrow your car, is that okay?

借.zh: 因为忘了带钱，所以我先跟朋友借了点。
借.en: Because I forgot to bring money, I borrowed a little from a friend first.

抓住.en: You need to seize this opportunity.

抓住.zh: 警察在街上抓住了那个小偷。
抓住.en: The police caught the thief on the street.

抓住.zh: 虽然很困难，但他还是抓住了最后的机会。
抓住.en: Although it was very difficult, he still seized the last chance.

东.en: The sun rises from the east.
Keep walking east and you'll arrive.
My home is on the east side of the city.

东.zh: 他向东指了指，说那里是公园。
东.en: He pointed east and said that's the park.

东.zh: 从这儿往东走十分钟，你会看到一个超市。
东.en: Walk east from here for ten minutes, you'll see a supermarket.

头发.zh: 他有一头漂亮的黑色头发。
因为经常染发，她的头发变得很干。
头发.en: Because she dyes her hair often, it has become very dry.

头发.zh: 我的头发太长了，得找个时间去剪一下。
头发.en: My hair is too long, I need to find time to get it cut.

封.zh: 请把这封信交给你妈妈。
封.en: Please give this letter to your mother.

封.zh: 虽然没写名字，但我知道这封信是谁寄的。
封.en: Although there's no name written, I know who sent this letter.

害怕.en: She's afraid to walk alone at night.

害怕.zh: 小时候我特别害怕黑暗。
害怕.en: When I was little, I was especially afraid of the dark.

害怕.zh: 他害怕考试不及格，所以一直在复习。
害怕.en: He's afraid of failing the exam, so he's been reviewing all along.

害怕.zh: 虽然看起来不怕，但她心里其实很害怕。
害怕.en: Although she looks unafraid, she's actually very scared inside.

乐.en: Everyone was so happy they kept laughing.

乐.zh: 他这人总是乐乐呵呵的。
因为赢了比赛，他乐得跳了起来。
乐.en: Because he won the game, he jumped for joy.

乐.zh: 虽然工作很累，但他每天都乐在其中。
乐.en: Although work is tiring, he enjoys it every day.

事实上.en: In fact, I don't know him.

事实上.zh: 他表面上生气，事实上并不在意。
事实上.en: He looks angry on the surface, but in fact he doesn't care.

事实上.zh: 这看起来很简单，事实上很难。
事实上.en: This looks simple, but in fact it's very difficult.

事实上.zh: 很多人以为他很笨，事实上他非常聪明。
事实上.en: Many people think he's stupid, but in fact he's very smart.

事实上.zh: 事实上，这件事跟我们一点关系都没有。
事实上.en: In fact, this matter has nothing to do with us.

季.en: The weather this season is very nice.

季.zh: 一年四季中，春天最舒服。
季.en: Among the four seasons, spring is the most comfortable.

季.zh: 因为冬天太冷，所以我喜欢温暖的季节。
季.en: Because winter is too cold, I like warm seasons.

季.zh: 虽然现在是夏天，但我觉得这个季不太热。
季.en: Although it's summer now, I think this season isn't too hot.

大概.zh: 因为没看到人，他大概已经走了。
大概.en: Since no one was seen, he probably already left.

大概.zh: 这个箱子大概有二十公斤。
你大概不知道，这件事其实很麻烦。
大概.en: You probably don't know, this matter is actually very troublesome.

蓝.zh: 我喜欢穿蓝色的衣服，因为很显白。
蓝.en: I like wearing blue clothes because they make me look fair.

蓝.zh: 虽然蓝色很漂亮，但我更喜欢绿色。
蓝.en: Although blue is pretty, I prefer green.

纸.en: Give me a piece of paper.
There's no paper in the kitchen.

纸.zh: 如果你要写信的话，我这里有纸。
纸.en: If you want to write a letter, I have paper here.

照顾.en: Take care of the child for a moment.

照顾.zh: 我生病的时候，妈妈一直照顾我。
照顾.en: When I was sick, mom took care of me all the time.

照顾.zh: 他一个人照顾不了那么多。
照顾.en: He can't take care of so many alone.

照顾.zh: 因为奶奶腿不好，所以需要人照顾。
照顾.en: Because grandma's legs are bad, she needs care.

文化.zh: 每个国家都有自己独特的文化。
文化.en: Every country has its own unique culture.

文化.zh: 我对日本文化很感兴趣。
文化.en: I'm very interested in Japanese culture.

文化.zh: 虽然文化不同，但我们还是能做好朋友。
文化.en: Although cultures are different, we can still be good friends.
This is a kind of culture.

急.zh: 他急着要去机场，所以没吃早饭。
急.en: He was in a hurry to go to the airport, so he didn't eat breakfast.
This matter is urgent, you need to hurry.

急.zh: 如果很急的话，你可以先走。
急.en: If it's urgent, you can leave first.

丢.zh: 别把垃圾丢在地上，要丢进垃圾桶。
丢.en: Don't throw trash on the ground, throw it into the trash can.

丢.zh: 因为不小心，我把手机丢了。
丢.en: Because I was careless, I lost my phone.

奇怪.zh: 他今天一直不说话，我觉得有点奇怪。
奇怪.en: He hasn't spoken all day, I think it's a bit strange.

奇怪.zh: 奇怪，我的书怎么不见了？
奇怪.en: Strange, how come my book is gone?

奇怪.zh: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但这是真的。
奇怪.en: Although it sounds strange, it's true.

慢慢.zh: 你不用着急，慢慢吃就好。
慢慢.en: You don't need to rush, just eat slowly.
The car is going very slowly, move slowly.

慢慢.zh: 虽然开始很难，但慢慢就会习惯了。
慢慢.en: Although it's hard at first, you'll gradually get used to it.

礼物.en: This is a gift for you.

礼物.zh: 我买了一份生日礼物送给妈妈。
礼物.en: I bought a birthday gift for mom.

礼物.zh: 如果你去他家，最好带一份礼物。
礼物.en: If you go to his house, it's best to bring a gift.

最好.en: This piece of clothing is the most beautiful.

最好.zh: 最好别去那儿，太危险了。
最好.en: Better not go there, it's too dangerous.

最好.zh: 我觉得你最好先问问妈妈。
最好.en: I think you'd better ask mom first.

最好.zh: 这个菜是我做得最好的。
最好.en: This dish is the best I've made.

南.en: My home is in the south.
Southern people like to eat rice.

南.zh: 这次旅行我们去了海南。
南.en: We went to Hainan on this trip.

南.zh: 虽然北京在北边，但上海在南边。
南.en: Although Beijing is in the north, Shanghai is in the south.

出发.en: What time do you leave home?
Don't forget your passport before departure.

出发.zh: 他们从火车站出发去爬山。
出发.en: They set off from the train station to go hiking.

出发.zh: 如果下雨，我们就推迟出发。
出发.en: If it rains, we'll postpone the departure.

提高.en: We need to improve work efficiency.

提高.zh: 多听多说能提高口语水平。
提高.en: Listening and speaking more can improve oral skills.

提高.zh: 公司最近提高了员工福利。
提高.en: The company recently raised employee benefits.

提高.zh: 为了提高汉语水平，他每天都在练习。
提高.en: To improve his Chinese level, he practices every day.

板.zh: 黑板上写着今天的作业。
板.en: The homework is written on the blackboard.
The floor is too slippery, careful not to fall.
Make a table using wooden boards.

板.zh: 虽然板子很旧，但还能用。
板.en: Although the board is old, it's still usable.

满意.en: I'm very satisfied with the result.
Are you satisfied with this job?

满意.zh: 他对自己的表现不太满意。
满意.en: He is not very satisfied with his performance.

满意.zh: 如果服务不满意，可以退款。
满意.en: If not satisfied with the service, you can get a refund.
This restaurant made me very satisfied.

旧.zh: 虽然房子很旧，但很舒服。
旧.en: Although the house is old, it's very comfortable.
There are many good books at the used book stall.

司机.zh: 公交司机每天都很辛苦。
司机.en: Bus drivers work hard every day.

司机.zh: 因为司机迷路了，所以我们迟到了。
司机.en: Because the driver got lost, we were late.

司机.zh: 出租车司机帮我搬了行李。
司机.en: The taxi driver helped me carry the luggage.

北.en: The north is very cold in winter.

北.zh: 从这儿向北走十分钟就到。
北.en: From here, walk north for ten minutes and you'll arrive.

北.zh: 北方人爱吃面食，南方人爱吃米饭。
北.en: Northerners like noodles, southerners like rice.
We plan to travel to the north.

好多.en: I bought a lot of fruit.

好多.zh: 因为下雨，所以路上有好多的水。
好多.en: Because it rained, there is a lot of water on the road.

好多.zh: 这个商场里的衣服好多种类。
好多.en: There are many kinds of clothes in this mall.

经理.en: The manager is very busy today.

经理.zh: 我们的经理对我们很严格，但是也很公平。
经理.en: Our manager is very strict with us, but also fair.
Have you met the new manager?

经理.zh: 因为经理出差了，所以今天会议取消了。
经理.en: Because the manager is on a business trip, today's meeting is cancelled.
The manager wants you to go to the office.

兴趣.en: I am very interested in music.

兴趣.zh: 除了工作，他最大的兴趣就是打篮球。
兴趣.en: Besides work, his biggest interest is playing basketball.

兴趣.zh: 因为我对历史很有兴趣，所以经常去博物馆。
兴趣.en: Because I am very interested in history, I often go to museums.

电子.zh: 现在很多公司都用电子支付，很方便。
电子.en: Now many companies use electronic payment, it's very convenient.

电子.zh: 他正在学电子工程，以后想当工程师。
电子.en: He is studying electronic engineering, and wants to be an engineer in the future.

员.zh: 他是我们公司的优秀员工。
员.en: He is an excellent employee of our company.

员.zh: 虽然这个俱乐部的会员很多，但是活动很少。
员.en: Although this club has many members, there are few activities.

员.zh: 他不仅是这个项目的成员，还是组长。
员.en: He is not only a member of this project, but also the team leader.

见面.zh: 很久没见面了，你最近怎么样？
见面.en: Long time no see, how have you been?
I want to meet and chat with you.

见面.zh: 因为下雨，所以我们改天再见面吧。
见面.en: Because it's raining, let's meet another day.

成绩.en: The grades are good this time.

成绩.zh: 他考试成绩很差，所以很难过。
成绩.en: His test scores were very bad, so he was very sad.
Did you get your report card?

成绩.zh: 虽然成绩很重要，但是健康更重要。
成绩.en: Although grades are important, health is more important.

中间.en: He is standing in the middle.

中间.zh: 我们中间有一个人说谎了，所以大家都很生气。
中间.en: There is one among us who lied, so everyone is very angry.
A vase of flowers is placed in the middle of the table.

中间.zh: 如果你坐在我和他中间，那么大家都能看到你。
中间.en: If you sit between me and him, then everyone can see you.
The one in the middle is mine.

女生.zh: 她是班上最漂亮的女生。
女生.en: She is the prettiest girl in class.

女生.zh: 今天来了很多新女生，大家都很开心。
女生.en: Today many new girls came, everyone is very happy.

女生.zh: 你认识那个穿红衣服的女生吗？
女生.en: Do you know that girl in red clothes?

女生.zh: 因为女生比较多，所以老师选了女生当班长。
女生.en: Because there are more girls, the teacher chose a girl as class monitor.

聪明.zh: 他虽然很聪明，但是不太努力。
聪明.en: Although he is very smart, he doesn't work very hard.

聪明.zh: 因为小明很聪明，所以老师经常表扬他。
聪明.en: Because Xiaoming is very smart, the teacher often praises him.

地点.zh: 这个地点太远了，我们换一个吧。
地点.en: This place is too far, let's change it.
Do you know the meeting place?

地点.zh: 因为天气不好，所以我们要改地点。
地点.en: Because the weather is bad, we need to change the location.

语言.en: How many languages can you speak?

语言.zh: 学习一门新语言需要很多耐心。
语言.en: Learning a new language requires a lot of patience.

语言.zh: 因为语言不同，我们交流有点困难。
语言.en: Because the languages are different, our communication is a bit difficult.
His body language is very rich.

语言.zh: 这个软件支持多种语言。

网站.zh: 我经常在这个网站上看新闻。
网站.en: I often read news on this website.

网站.zh: 虽然网站更新了，但功能没变。
网站.en: Although the website was updated, the functions haven't changed.

网站.zh: 我们公司最近做了一个新网站。
网站.en: Our company recently made a new website.

灯.zh: 晚上看书的时候一定要开灯。
灯.en: When reading at night, you must turn on the light.

灯.zh: 因为灯坏了，所以房间里很暗。
灯.en: Because the light is broken, the room is very dark.
He bought a new desk lamp.

太阳.zh: 今天的太阳特别大，记得涂防晒霜。
太阳.en: Today's sun is particularly strong, remember to apply sunscreen.

太阳.zh: 如果太阳下山了，我们就回家。
太阳.en: If the sun sets, we'll go home.
I like to bask in the sun.
The sun rises from the east.

方便.zh: 有地铁的话，出行会很方便。
方便.en: With the subway, traveling will be very convenient.

方便.zh: 虽然贵一点，但是方便很多。
方便.en: Although a bit more expensive, it's much more convenient.

方便.zh: 这个超市二十四小时营业，很方便。
方便.en: This supermarket is open 24 hours, very convenient.

方便.zh: 请问附近有方便停车的地方吗？
方便.en: Excuse me, is there a convenient place to park nearby?

爬.zh: 他们昨天爬了一座很高的山。
爬.en: They climbed a very high mountain yesterday.

爬.zh: 因为楼梯太陡，爬上去很累。
爬.en: Because the stairs are too steep, climbing up is very tiring.

爬.zh: 小猫爬到树上下不来了。
爬.en: The kitten climbed up the tree and can't get down.

爬.zh: 他每天爬五层楼锻炼身体。
爬.en: He climbs five floors every day to exercise.

差不多.zh: 这两件衣服的价格差不多。
差不多.en: The prices of these two clothes are about the same.

差不多.zh: 虽然颜色不同，但款式差不多。
差不多.en: Although the colors are different, the styles are about the same.

差不多.zh: 他差不多每天都来这儿。
差不多.en: He comes here almost every day.

差不多.zh: 我差不多花了两个小时才完成。
差不多.en: It took me almost two hours to finish.

冰.en: Give me a glass of ice water.
Eating icy watermelon in summer is especially refreshing.

冰.zh: 因为路上有冰，开车要小心。
冰.en: Because there is ice on the road, drive carefully.
I don't like drinks with ice.

糖.en: Don't add too much sugar to the coffee.

糖.zh: 如果你觉得苦，可以加点糖。
糖.en: If you think it's bitter, you can add some sugar.
Children all like to eat candy.

糖.zh: 这种糖是从水果里提取的。
糖.en: This sugar is extracted from fruit.

以下.en: Free for under three years old.
The following content is an important notice.

以下.zh: 如果你符合以下条件，就可以申请。
以下.en: If you meet the following conditions, you can apply.
The following are some of my suggestions.

合适.zh: 这个时间开会不合适吧？
合适.en: Is this time not suitable for a meeting?

合适.zh: 我觉得这个方案不太合适，因为成本太高。
合适.en: I think this plan is not very suitable because the cost is too high.

合适.zh: 你帮我看看这个颜色合不合适？
合适.en: Help me see if this color is suitable?

合适.zh: 找一个合适的房子不容易。
合适.en: Finding a suitable house is not easy.

号码.zh: 这个号码打不通，你再查一下。
号码.en: This number can't get through, check again.

号码.zh: 我们要换一个新的门牌号码。
号码.en: We need to change to a new house number.

出生.en: He was born in a small city.

出生.zh: 她出生的时候，家里都很高兴。
出生.en: When she was born, the family was very happy.

出生.zh: 你知道他的出生日期吗？
出生.en: Do you know his date of birth?

出生.zh: 这个孩子刚出生就哭得很厉害。
出生.en: This child cried loudly as soon as he was born.

生气.zh: 他今天看起来有点生气。
生气.en: He looks a bit angry today.

生气.zh: 妈妈很生气，因为我没写完作业。
生气.en: Mom is very angry because I didn't finish my homework.
When she gets angry, she doesn't speak.

以上.en: Those above 10 years old can participate.

以上.zh: 以上是我对这件事的看法。
以上.en: Above is my opinion on this matter.

以上.zh: 如果你有问题，请参考以上说明。
以上.en: If you have questions, please refer to the above instructions.

以上.zh: 这个产品适合六十岁以上的人。
以上.en: This product is suitable for people over 60.
Please read the above content carefully.

名单.en: Is your name on the list?

名单.zh: 我们需要一份新的名单。

名单.en: He is checking the award list.

公园.en: This park is big and beautiful.

公园.zh: 每个周末他都带孩子在公园玩。
公园.en: Every weekend he takes his kids to play in the park.

公园.zh: 公园里有很多人在散步。
公园.en: There are many people walking in the park.

公园.zh: 离我家最近的公园走路五分钟。
公园.en: The nearest park to my home is a five-minute walk.

热情.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality.

热情.zh: 他对工作一直充满热情。
热情.en: He has always been enthusiastic about work.
The waiter's attitude is very warm.

到处.zh: 我到处问过了，没人知道。
到处.en: I asked everywhere, no one knows.

的话.zh: 如果方便的话，请早点来。
你不喜欢的话，我们可以换一个。
的话.en: If you don't like it, we can change.

的话.zh: 有时间的话，我们一起吃饭。
的话.en: If you have time, let's eat together.

的话.zh: 要是下雨的话，我们就不去了。
的话.en: If it rains, we won't go.

骑.en: I ride a bike to work.

骑.zh: 他每天骑摩托车去学校，但今天没骑。
骑.en: He rides a motorcycle to school every day, but today he didn't.

骑.zh: 骑马的叔叔是我爸爸的朋友。
骑.en: The uncle riding a horse is my dad's friend.

骑.zh: 因为下雨，所以我不想骑电动车。
骑.en: Because it's raining, I don't want to ride the e-bike.

报纸.zh: 我每天早上都看报纸，了解新闻。
报纸.en: I read the newspaper every morning to catch up on news.

报纸.zh: 虽然现在有手机，但我还是喜欢看报纸。
报纸.en: Although there are phones now, I still like reading newspapers.
He put the newspaper on the table.

河.zh: 夏天的时候，孩子们喜欢在河里游泳。
河.en: In summer, kids like to swim in the river.

河.zh: 因为河水太脏，所以我们不能钓鱼。
河.en: Because the river water is too dirty, we can't fish.
Across the river there is a small village.

河.zh: 我们沿着河走了一小时。
河.en: We walked along the river for an hour.

搬.en: Please help me move the table.

搬.zh: 我们下周要搬到新家去。
搬.en: We are moving to a new house next week.

搬.zh: 如果太重，你就别自己搬。
搬.en: If it's too heavy, don't carry it yourself.
He carried a case of water upstairs.

练.zh: 为了比赛，他练了一个月的跑步。
练.en: For the competition, he practiced running for a month.

练.zh: 虽然很累，但我还是坚持练。
练.en: Although very tired, I still persist in practicing.
We need to practice speaking more.

聊.zh: 昨天晚上我和朋友聊了很久。
聊.en: Last night I chatted with my friend for a long time.

聊.zh: 如果没事，我们可以聊聊电影。
聊.en: If you're free, we can chat about movies.

聊.zh: 我喜欢跟妈妈聊学校的事。
聊.en: I like to chat with mom about school stuff.

同事.zh: 今天我和同事一起吃了午饭。
同事.en: Today I had lunch with my colleague.

同事.zh: 因为同事请假，所以我今天很忙。
同事.en: Because my colleague took leave, I'm very busy today.
What's the name of the new colleague?
My colleague helped me revise the report.

体育.zh: 他体育很好，跑步特别快。
体育.en: He is good at sports, runs very fast.

体育.zh: 虽然我不爱体育，但会每天运动。
体育.en: Although I don't like sports, I exercise every day.
Our school has a sports field.

大人.zh: 小时候我总想快点成为大人。
大人.en: When I was little, I always wanted to become an adult quickly.

大人.zh: 这件事只有大人才能做。
大人.en: This can only be done by adults.
Adults are talking, kids don't interrupt.

大人.zh: 你已经是大人了，要自己负责。
大人.en: You're an adult now, you have to be responsible for yourself.

角.en: There's a table in that corner.

角.zh: 三角形的三个角加起来是一百八十度。
角.en: The three angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees.

角.zh: 虽然他在角落，但我还是能看到他。
角.en: Although he is in the corner, I can still see him.

角.zh: 请你把椅子放到那个角。
角.en: Please put the chair in that corner.

老人.en: The old man is walking in the park.

老人.zh: 那位老人每天都会在小区里遛狗。
老人.en: That old man walks his dog in the neighborhood every day.

老人.zh: 老人喜欢坐在树下喝茶。
老人.en: The old person likes to sit under the tree and drink tea.

老人.zh: 虽然老人年纪很大，但身体很健康。
老人.en: Although the old man is very old, he is healthy.
There are many old people in our neighborhood.

胖.zh: 你最近好像胖了不少，是不是吃太多了？
胖.en: You seem to have gained a lot of weight recently, have you been eating too much?
My cat is getting fatter and fatter.

胖.zh: 因为不运动，所以越来越胖。
胖.en: Because he doesn't exercise, he gets fatter and fatter.
Overweight people should watch their diet.

页.zh: 这本书有三百多页，我还没看完。
页.en: This book has over 300 pages, and I haven't finished it yet.

页.zh: 如果你看不懂，就看一下前一页。
页.en: If you don't understand, just look at the previous page.

页.zh: 我的笔记本写满了二十页。
页.en: My notebook is filled with twenty pages of writing.

不见.zh: 刚才还在这里，怎么一眨眼就不见了？
不见.en: It was here just now, how did it disappear in the blink of an eye?
I haven't seen him for a long time, where did he go?

不见.zh: 如果明天还不见你，我就报警了。
不见.en: If I still don't see you tomorrow, I'll call the police.

干净.zh: 这个房间收拾得很干净，看起来很舒服。
干净.en: This room is tidied up very clean, it looks comfortable.
The clothes are washed clean and tidy.

干净.zh: 虽然地板看起来很干净，但还是需要拖一遍。
干净.en: Although the floor looks clean, you still need to mop it once.

放心.zh: 你一个人去吧，我很放心。
放心.en: Go ahead alone, I feel relieved.

放心.zh: 孩子在学校很安全，你就放心吧。
放心.en: The child is safe at school, you can rest assured.

放心.zh: 只要按时吃药，你的病就会好，放心。
放心.en: As long as you take your medicine on time, you'll get better, rest assured.

放心.zh: 把这件事交给我，你放心。
放心.en: Leave this to me, you can trust me.

草.en: There are flowers on the grass.
Spring has come, the grass has turned green.
We sat on the grass and chatted.

草.zh: 因为下雨了，草长得很高。
草.en: Because it rained, the grass grew very tall.

甜.zh: 你做的蛋糕真甜，太好吃了。
甜.en: The cake you made is really sweet, so delicious.

甜.zh: 我喜欢甜的食物，比如巧克力。
甜.en: I like sweet foods, like chocolate.

甜.zh: 虽然奶茶很甜，但是喝多了对身体不好。
甜.en: Although milk tea is very sweet, drinking too much is bad for your health.

安静.en: Please be quiet for a moment.

安静.zh: 图书馆里非常安静，大家都在看书。
安静.en: The library is very quiet, everyone is reading.
This child is especially quiet today.

安静.zh: 因为太安静了，我有点害怕。
安静.en: Because it's too quiet, I'm a bit scared.

安静.zh: 我们需要一个安静的地方谈话。
安静.en: We need a quiet place to talk.

牙.en: You need to brush your teeth every morning and evening.

牙.zh: 如果牙疼的话，就去看牙医。
牙.en: If your tooth hurts, go see a dentist.

羊.zh: 草原上有好多白色的羊。
羊.en: There are many white sheep on the grassland.

羊.zh: 今天中午我们吃炖羊肉，很好吃。
羊.en: We had braised lamb for lunch today, it was delicious.

羊.zh: 他养了三只羊，每天都要去放羊。
羊.en: He keeps three sheep and has to herd them every day.

羊.zh: 虽然羊看起来很温顺，但其实脾气也很大。
羊.en: Although sheep look gentle, they can actually have a big temper.

作业.zh: 今天的作业特别多，我写了好久。
作业.en: Today's homework is especially heavy; I wrote for a long time.

作业.zh: 老师布置的作业明天要交，别忘记。
作业.en: The homework assigned by the teacher is due tomorrow, don't forget.

作业.zh: 我先做完作业，然后再去看电视。
作业.en: I'll finish my homework first, then watch TV.

作业.zh: 虽然作业很难，但是我还是坚持做完了。
作业.en: Although the homework was hard, I still persisted and finished it.

瘦.en: You've lost a lot of weight recently.
He is as thin as a bamboo pole.

瘦.zh: 她虽然瘦，但是力气却不小。
瘦.en: Although she is thin, she is not weak in strength.

瘦.zh: 吃太多快餐容易让人变瘦吗？不会的。
瘦.en: Does eating too much fast food make you thin? No, it doesn't.

瘦.zh: 这件衣服太瘦了，我穿不进去。
瘦.en: This piece of clothing is too tight; I can't put it on.

啤酒.en: Drinking ice-cold beer in summer is the best.

啤酒.zh: 他不喜欢喝啤酒，只喝白酒。
啤酒.en: He doesn't like drinking beer, only liquor.

啤酒.zh: 我们一边吃烧烤一边喝啤酒，聊得很开心。
啤酒.en: We had barbecue and beer while chatting happily.

啤酒.zh: 啤酒虽然好喝，但喝多了对身体不好。
啤酒.en: Although beer tastes good, drinking too much is bad for your health.

蛋糕.zh: 我生日那天买了一个大蛋糕。
蛋糕.en: I bought a big cake on my birthday.

蛋糕.zh: 妈妈做的蛋糕比外面卖的好吃多了。
蛋糕.en: The cake my mom makes is much tastier than the ones sold outside.

蛋糕.zh: 他切蛋糕的时候不小心弄了一手奶油。
蛋糕.en: When he cut the cake, he accidentally got cream all over his hand.

蛋糕.zh: 我们给她准备了一个惊喜蛋糕，她感动得哭了。
蛋糕.en: We prepared a surprise cake for her, and she was so moved she cried.

新鲜.zh: 每天早上我都去市场买新鲜蔬菜。
新鲜.en: Every morning I go to the market to buy fresh vegetables.

新鲜.zh: 水果要趁新鲜的时候吃，放久了就不甜了。
新鲜.en: Fruit should be eaten when fresh; if stored too long, it won't be sweet.

新鲜.zh: 我刚搬到这个城市，对一切都感到很新鲜。
新鲜.en: I just moved to this city and everything feels new and fresh.

新鲜.zh: 虽然这家店不大，但他们的面包一直很新鲜。
新鲜.en: Although this shop is small, their bread is always fresh.

看上去.en: This piece of clothing looks good.

看上去.zh: 他看上去挺年轻的，其实已经四十多了。
看上去.en: He looks quite young, but he's actually over forty.

看上去.zh: 这盘菜看上去很好吃，但吃起来一般。
看上去.en: This dish looks delicious, but it tastes ordinary.

看上去.zh: 虽然问题看上去很简单，但实际上很难。
看上去.en: Although the problem looks simple, it's actually very difficult.

难过.zh: 听到这个消息，他难过极了。
难过.en: Hearing the news, he was extremely sad.

难过.zh: 考试没考好，我难过得一晚上没睡着。
难过.en: I didn't do well on the exam and was so sad that I couldn't sleep all night.

难过.zh: 看到朋友受伤，我心里特别难过。
难过.en: Seeing my friend injured, I felt very sad inside.

难过.zh: 虽然事情已经过去了，但每次想起来我还是很难过。
难过.en: Although it's over, I still feel sad every time I think about it.

不久.zh: 我们结婚不久就有了孩子。
不久.en: Not long after we got married, we had a child.

不久.zh: 她回国不久就找到了一份好工作。
不久.en: Soon after returning to her country, she found a good job.

不久.zh: 不久以前，这里还是一片荒地。
不久.en: Not long ago, this place was still a wasteland.

不久.zh: 只要努力，不久之后你一定会进步的。
不久.en: As long as you work hard, you will surely improve before long.

客人.en: We have a guest at home.

客人.zh: 客人还没到，我们先准备一下。
客人.en: The guests haven't arrived yet; let's prepare first.

客人.zh: 今天的客人很多，桌子都不够用了。
客人.en: There are many guests today; there aren't enough tables.

客人.zh: 他作为客人，不好意思主动点菜。
客人.en: As a guest, he felt embarrassed to order dishes proactively.

客人.zh: 虽然客人要求很多，但我们都尽量满足了。
客人.en: Although the guests had many requests, we tried our best to satisfy them.

常常.en: I often go to that store.

常常.zh: 她常常迟到，老师有点不高兴。
常常.en: She is often late, and the teacher is a bit unhappy.

常常.zh: 周末我常常和朋友一起打球。
常常.en: I often play ball with friends on weekends.

常常.zh: 虽然常常下雨，但我们还是出去了。
常常.en: Although it often rains, we still went out.

常常.zh: 他常常熬夜，所以白天很困。
常常.en: He often stays up late, so he is very sleepy during the day.

平时.zh: 他平时很安静，今天却说了很多话。
平时.en: He is usually quiet, but today he talked a lot.
How do you usually go to work?

平时.zh: 平时我七点起床，周末会晚一点。
平时.en: I usually get up at seven, but on weekends I get up a bit later.

平时.zh: 她平时成绩不错，可这次考试没考好。
平时.en: She usually has good grades, but she didn't do well on this exam.

男生.en: That boy is my younger brother.

男生.zh: 班上有十个男生，十五个女生。
男生.en: There are ten boys and fifteen girls in the class.

男生.zh: 这个男生唱歌特别好听。
虽然他是个男生，但做饭很厉害。
男生.en: Although he is a boy, he is very good at cooking.

男生.zh: 我们学校的男生都喜欢打篮球。
男生.en: The boys in our school all like to play basketball.

赶到.en: We finally arrived at the station in time.

赶到.zh: 他赶到的时候，电影已经开始了。
赶到.en: By the time he arrived, the movie had already started.

赶到.zh: 为了赶上飞机，我一大早就赶到机场。
赶到.en: To catch the plane, I rushed to the airport early in the morning.

赶到.zh: 她拼命跑，总算赶到了教室。
赶到.en: She ran desperately and finally made it to the classroom.

赶到.zh: 因为路上堵车，我没能及时赶到。
赶到.en: Because of traffic jams, I couldn't arrive on time.

碗.en: This bowl was bought by Mom.
Remember to wash the bowls after eating.
He ate three bowls of rice in one go.

碗.zh: 桌上放着两个碗和一双筷子。
碗.en: There are two bowls and a pair of chopsticks on the table.

懂得.zh: 小孩子不懂得安全的重要性。
懂得.en: Children don't understand the importance of safety.
He knows how to fix computers.

懂得.zh: 只有真正经历过，才懂得其中的苦。
懂得.en: Only by truly experiencing it can one understand the hardship in it.

懂得.zh: 她懂得很多道理，但有时做不到。
懂得.en: She understands many principles, but sometimes can't act on them.

好久.en: We waited a long time before he came.
I haven't eaten this dish for a long time.

好久.zh: 好久没下雨了，地都干了。
好久.en: It hasn't rained for a long time, and the ground is dry.

好久.zh: 他离开了好久，我们都想他了。
好久.en: He has been away for a long time, and we all miss him.

夏天.zh: 夏天的时候，我们常去海边。
夏天.en: In summer, we often go to the beach.

夏天.zh: 今年夏天比去年热多了。
夏天.en: This summer is much hotter than last year.

夏天.zh: 虽然夏天很热，但可以吃冰淇淋。
夏天.en: Although summer is hot, you can eat ice cream.

以外.zh: 除了吃饭以外，我什么都不想做。
以外.en: Apart from eating, I don't want to do anything.

以外.zh: 除了中文以外，他还会说英文。
以外.en: Besides Chinese, he can also speak English.

以外.zh: 除了周末以外，我每天都要上班。
以外.en: Except for weekends, I have to go to work every day.

以外.zh: 除了这件事以外，其他我都答应了。
以外.en: Except for this matter, I agreed to everything else.

数学.en: The math exam is very hard.
His math grades have always been good.

数学.zh: 虽然数学很难，但我还是努力学。
数学.en: Although math is hard, I still study hard.

数学.zh: 我弟弟的数学比英语好得多。
数学.en: My younger brother is much better at math than English.

刷.en: I brush my teeth twice a day.

刷.zh: 他一边刷手机一边吃饭。
刷.en: He eats while scrolling on his phone.

刷.zh: 你刷完卡就可以进去了。
刷.en: After you swipe the card, you can go in.

刷.zh: 因为手机没电了，所以不能刷视频。
刷.en: Because the phone is dead, I can't scroll through videos.

练习.zh: 这个钢琴曲需要多练习才能弹好。
练习.en: This piano piece needs more practice to play well.

练习.zh: 虽然练习很难，但是很有用。
练习.en: Although practice is hard, it is very useful.

练习.zh: 我们明天一起练习口语吧。

看起来.zh: 这道菜看起来很好吃，我想尝一下。
看起来.en: This dish looks delicious; I want to taste it.

看起来.zh: 看起来要下雨了，我们带伞吧。
看起来.en: It looks like it's going to rain; let's bring an umbrella.

看起来.zh: 虽然他很年轻，但看起来很有经验。
看起来.en: Although he is young, he seems very experienced.

看起来.zh: 那个书包看起来不错，多少钱？
看起来.en: That backpack looks good; how much is it?

放到.en: Put the book on the table.

放到.zh: 请把垃圾放到垃圾桶里。
放到.en: Please put the trash into the trash can.
I put the keys in my bag.

放到.zh: 如果你不用，就放到抽屉里。
放到.en: If you don't use it, put it in the drawer.

放到.zh: 别把热的东西直接放到玻璃桌上。
放到.en: Don't put hot things directly on the glass table.

国内.zh: 这个品牌在国内很受欢迎。
国内.en: This brand is very popular domestically.

国内.zh: 你想在国内还是国外读书？
国内.en: Do you want to study in China or abroad?

国内.zh: 虽然国内价格便宜，但质量也不错。
国内.en: Although domestic prices are cheap, the quality is also good.

国内.zh: 我最近在国内旅游了很多地方。
国内.en: I have traveled to many places in China recently.

能不能.zh: 你能不能小声一点？我在看书。
能不能.en: Can you be a little quieter? I am reading.

能不能.zh: 这个周末你能不能来参加派对？
能不能.en: Can you come to the party this weekend?

能不能.zh: 如果你有时间，能不能教我做这道菜？
能不能.en: If you have time, can you teach me to cook this dish?

能不能.zh: 我不知道他能不能准时到。
能不能.en: I don't know if he can arrive on time.

新年.zh: 我们新年的时候会去外婆家。
新年.en: We will go to grandma's house during the New Year.
What are your New Year wishes?

新年.zh: 因为新年要到了，所以大家都很开心。
新年.en: Because the New Year is coming, everyone is very happy.
Wearing new clothes for the New Year is a tradition.

运动员.zh: 这些运动员训练非常刻苦。

运动员.en: She has wanted to be an athlete since she was little.

运动员.zh: 虽然运动员很累，但他们坚持比赛。
运动员.en: Although the athletes are tired, they persist in the competition.

运动员.zh: 中国运动员在奥运会上表现很好。
运动员.en: Chinese athletes performed very well at the Olympics.

姐妹.zh: 我和我的姐妹经常一起逛街。
姐妹.en: My sisters and I often go shopping together.

姐妹.zh: 她们姐妹俩长得非常像。
姐妹.en: The two sisters look very much alike.

姐妹.zh: 虽然她们是姐妹，但性格完全不同。
姐妹.en: Although they are sisters, their personalities are completely different.

姐妹.zh: 我的姐妹住在另一个城市。
姐妹.en: My sister lives in another city.

南方.zh: 我来自中国的南方城市。
南方.en: I come from a southern city in China.

南方.zh: 南方和北方的饮食不一样。
南方.en: The food in the south and the north is different.

南方.zh: 因为南方天气潮湿，所以容易下雨。
南方.en: Because the weather in the south is humid, it rains easily.

南方.zh: 冬天去南方旅游比较好。
南方.en: It's better to travel to the south in winter.

尝.zh: 你尝一下这个菜，味道不错。
尝.en: Try this dish, it tastes good.

尝.zh: 我从来没尝过这么辣的火锅。
尝.en: I've never tasted such a spicy hotpot.

尝.zh: 你先尝一小口，如果不喜欢就别吃了。
尝.en: Take a small bite first; if you don't like it, don't eat it.

尝.zh: 他尝了一口汤，觉得太咸了。
尝.en: He tasted a spoonful of soup and found it too salty.

尝.zh: 虽然看起来不好看，但你要不要尝一尝？
尝.en: It doesn't look good, but would you like to give it a taste?

对话.zh: 他们俩的对话很有意思。
这段对话里有很多新的词汇。
对话.en: There are many new words in this dialogue.

对话.zh: 我们需要和对方进行一次认真的对话。
对话.en: We need to have a serious conversation with the other party.

对话.zh: 看电影时，我喜欢注意角色的对话。
对话.en: When watching a movie, I like to pay attention to the characters' dialogues.

对话.zh: 如果你有问题，直接找他对话就行。
对话.en: If you have any questions, just go and talk to him directly.

冬天.en: Winter is very cold, so wear more clothes.

冬天.zh: 我最喜欢冬天，因为可以滑冰。
冬天.en: I like winter the most because I can ice skate.

冬天.zh: 这里的冬天经常下大雪，出门要小心。
冬天.en: It often snows heavily here in winter, so be careful when going out.

冬天.zh: 冬天的时候，我们一家人喜欢围着火炉聊天。
冬天.en: In winter, our family likes to sit around the fireplace and chat.

冬天.zh: 虽然冬天很冷，但是能看到雪景还是很美的。
冬天.en: Although winter is very cold, it's still beautiful to see the snow scenery.

邻居.zh: 邻居家养了一只猫，特别可爱。
邻居.en: The neighbor's house has a cat that is very cute.

邻居.zh: 我们和邻居关系很好，经常互相帮忙。
邻居.en: We have a good relationship with our neighbors and often help each other.

邻居.zh: 新搬来的邻居是个年轻的老师。
邻居.en: The newly moved-in neighbor is a young teacher.

邻居.zh: 因为邻居太吵，我晚上很难睡着。
邻居.en: Because the neighbors are too noisy, I have trouble sleeping at night.

分开.zh: 这两个词的意思不一样，要分开记。
分开.en: These two words have different meanings, so memorize them separately.

分开.zh: 他们在一起三年了，最后还是分开了。
分开.en: They were together for three years, but in the end they separated.

分开.zh: 把这些垃圾按可回收和不可回收分开。
分开.en: Separate these trash into recyclable and non-recyclable.

分开.zh: 虽然我们要分开一段时间，但我会每天给你打电话。
分开.en: Although we'll be apart for a while, I'll call you every day.

校长.en: The principal came to our class today.

校长.zh: 我们学校的校长很年轻。
校长.en: The principal of our school is very young.

校长.zh: 校长在开学典礼上讲了话。
校长.en: The principal gave a speech at the opening ceremony.

校长.zh: 有问题可以直接去找校长反映。
校长.en: If you have a problem, you can go directly to the principal to report it.

校长.zh: 校长说下周五要举办运动会，请大家准备。
校长.en: The principal said there will be a sports meet next Friday, so everyone please prepare.

自行车.en: I ride a bike to work.

自行车.zh: 自行车比开车环保多了。
自行车.en: Bicycles are much more environmentally friendly than driving.

自行车.zh: 我的自行车坏了，需要修一下。
自行车.en: My bike is broken; it needs to be repaired.

自行车.zh: 昨天在公园里骑自行车，差点摔了。
自行车.en: Yesterday I rode my bike in the park and almost fell.

相机.zh: 出门旅游别忘了带相机。
相机.en: Don't forget to bring your camera when traveling.

相机.zh: 我用相机拍了很多漂亮的照片。
相机.en: I took many beautiful photos with my camera.

相机.zh: 这个相机功能很多，但是操作有点复杂。
相机.en: This camera has many functions, but the operation is a bit complicated.

花园.en: There is a small garden behind my house.

花园.zh: 花园里种了很多玫瑰花。
花园.en: Many roses are planted in the garden.

花园.zh: 每天早晨我都在花园里散步。
花园.en: I take a walk in the garden every morning.

花园.zh: 这个花园虽然不大，但是很漂亮。
花园.en: Although this garden is not big, it is very beautiful.

花园.zh: 孩子们在花园里跑来跑去，玩得很开心。
花园.en: The children are running around in the garden, having a great time.

遇见.zh: 昨天我在街上遇见了他。
遇见.en: Yesterday I met him on the street.

遇见.zh: 真没想到会在这里遇见你。
遇见.en: I never expected to meet you here.

遇见.zh: 去旅行的路上遇见了很多有趣的人。
遇见.en: I met many interesting people on the trip.

遇见.zh: 如果遇见什么问题，随时可以打电话给我。
遇见.en: If you encounter any problems, you can call me anytime.

遇见.zh: 她是在图书馆遇见了她的男朋友。
遇见.en: She met her boyfriend at the library.

夫妻.zh: 这对夫妻每天一起做饭。
夫妻.en: This couple cooks together every day.

夫妻.zh: 虽然他们是夫妻，但性格很不同。
夫妻.en: Although they are husband and wife, their personalities are very different.

夫妻.zh: 那对老夫妻结婚五十年了。
夫妻.en: That old couple has been married for fifty years.

耳朵.zh: 他耳朵很红，可能是感冒了。
耳朵.en: His ears are red, maybe he caught a cold.

耳朵.zh: 我大声喊，但他耳朵不好听不见。
耳朵.en: I shouted loudly, but his ears are not good so he couldn't hear.

耳朵.zh: 她耳朵上戴了一对耳环。
耳朵.en: She is wearing a pair of earrings on her ears.
Please bring your ear closer to listen.

饮料.zh: 冰箱里有很多种饮料，你自己选吧。
饮料.en: There are many kinds of drinks in the fridge, pick yourself.

饮料.zh: 因为天气太热，所以我买了一杯冰饮料。
饮料.en: Because the weather is too hot, I bought an iced drink.
This drink has high sugar content.

饮料.zh: 服务员，请给我们两杯饮料。
饮料.en: Waiter, please give us two drinks.

节日.zh: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。
节日.en: Spring Festival is China's most important traditional festival.

节日.zh: 虽然节日很热闹，但我更喜欢待在家里。
节日.en: Although the festival is lively, I prefer to stay at home.

节日.zh: 每个节日都有不同的习俗。

节日.en: During the festival, there are many people on the streets.

整天.en: He plays on his phone all day.

整天.zh: 我整天忙着工作，连饭都没时间吃。
整天.en: I'm busy working all day, no time even to eat.

整天.zh: 如果你整天不运动，身体会变差。
整天.en: If you don't exercise all day, your health will worsen.
She stays at home reading all day.

整天.zh: 别整天抱怨，做点有用的事。
整天.en: Don't complain all day, do something useful.

叔叔.zh: 叔叔，你能帮我一个忙吗？
叔叔.en: Uncle, can you help me with a favor?

叔叔.zh: 因为我爸爸出差，所以叔叔来接我放学。
叔叔.en: Because my dad is on a business trip, uncle picked me up from school.
Uncle and aunt live in Beijing.

洗澡.en: I'm going to take a shower.

洗澡.zh: 因为运动出了一身汗，所以我必须马上洗澡。
洗澡.en: Because I sweated from exercise, I must take a shower immediately.
How many times do you shower a day?

洗澡.zh: 小孩子洗澡时要注意安全。
洗澡.en: When children bathe, pay attention to safety.

部长.zh: 今天下午部长要开一个重要的会议。
部长.en: This afternoon the minister will hold an important meeting.

部长.zh: 虽然部长很忙，但他还是抽空参加了活动。
部长.en: Although the minister is busy, he still took time to attend the event.

部长.zh: 这位部长负责教育事务。
部长.en: This minister is in charge of education affairs.

部长.zh: 部长在讲话中提到了这个问题。
部长.en: The minister mentioned this issue in his speech.

地图.zh: 这张地图显示了我们学校的位置。
地图.en: This map shows the location of our school.

地图.zh: 因为手机没电了，所以我只能看纸质地图。
地图.en: Because my phone died, I can only look at a paper map.
Don't forget to bring a map before going out.

地图.zh: 他在地图上找到了那个城市。
地图.en: He found that city on the map.

晚会.zh: 我们学校每年都举办新年晚会。
晚会.en: Our school holds a New Year's party every year.

晚会.zh: 虽然晚会很精彩，但我要早点回家准备考试。
晚会.en: Although the party was wonderful, I need to go home early to prepare for the exam.

晚会.zh: 晚会上的表演非常有趣。
晚会.en: The performances at the party were very interesting.

晚会.zh: 她穿了一条漂亮的裙子去参加晚会。
晚会.en: She wore a beautiful dress to attend the party.

感冒.en: Drinking more warm water can cure a cold.

感冒.zh: 他因为感冒所以没来上班。
感冒.en: He didn't come to work because he had a cold.

感冒.zh: 感冒的时候要好好休息。
感冒.en: You need to rest well when you have a cold.

感冒.zh: 你感冒了，要不要吃点药？
感冒.en: You have a cold, do you want to take some medicine?

大小.en: Are these shoes the right size?

大小.zh: 房子的大小不重要，舒服就行。
大小.en: The size of the house doesn't matter, as long as it's comfortable.

大小.zh: 你帮我看看这两个盒子的大小一样吗？
大小.en: Help me check if these two boxes are the same size.

大小.zh: 大小事情都要认真对待。
大小.en: We should take both big and small matters seriously.

大小.zh: 这件衣服大小有点偏大，我换小一号的。
大小.en: This clothing runs a bit large; I'll exchange for a smaller size.

迟到.zh: 早上堵车，所以我迟到了。
迟到.en: There was a traffic jam in the morning, so I was late.
Being late three times will result in a pay deduction.

迟到.zh: 对不起，我迟到了十分钟。
迟到.en: Sorry, I was ten minutes late.

迟到.zh: 你最好提前出门，免得迟到。
迟到.en: You'd better leave early to avoid being late.

得分.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但他们的得分比上次高。
得分.en: Although they lost the game, their score was higher than last time.

得分.zh: 老师说我作文得分不错。
得分.en: The teacher said my essay got a good score.

刻.en: It's a quarter past one now.

刻.zh: 差一刻到六点，我们得快点。
刻.en: It's a quarter to six, we need to hurry.

刻.zh: 他刻了一个木雕送给我。
刻.en: He carved a wooden sculpture and gave it to me.
There are characters carved on that stone.

刻.zh: 你等一刻钟，我马上回来。
刻.en: Wait for a quarter of an hour, I'll be right back.

锻炼.en: More exercise is good for your health.

锻炼.zh: 她喜欢早上跑步来锻炼。
锻炼.en: She likes to run in the morning to exercise.

锻炼.zh: 就算再忙，也要抽时间锻炼。
锻炼.en: Even if you're busy, you should make time to exercise.
