高速公路.en: After you get on the expressway, remember to look at the road signs.

起飞.en: The plane is about to take off.

起飞.zh: 因为天气不好，我们的航班推迟起飞了。
起飞.en: Because of bad weather, our flight was delayed for takeoff.

起飞.zh: 起飞的时候请系好安全带。
起飞.en: Please fasten your seatbelt during takeoff.

起飞.zh: 虽然晚了半小时，但飞机终于安全起飞了。
起飞.en: Although it was half an hour late, the plane finally took off safely.

网球.zh: 周末我和朋友去体育馆打网球。
网球.en: On weekends, I go to the gym to play tennis with friends.

网球.zh: 如果天气好，我们就在户外打网球。
网球.en: If the weather is good, we'll play tennis outdoors.

网球.zh: 他不仅会打网球，还会游泳。
网球.en: He not only can play tennis, but also can swim.

裙子.zh: 她穿了一条红色的裙子去参加派对。
裙子.en: She wore a red skirt to attend the party.

裙子.zh: 夏天的时候，女生都喜欢穿短裙子。
裙子.en: In summer, girls like to wear short skirts.

裙子.zh: 因为太冷了，她没穿裙子，换成了裤子。
裙子.en: Because it was too cold, she didn't wear a skirt and changed into pants.

香蕉.en: Eating bananas is good for your health.

香蕉.zh: 我每天早上都会吃一根香蕉。
香蕉.en: I eat a banana every morning.

香蕉.zh: 把香蕉和牛奶一起搅拌，可以做奶昔。
香蕉.en: Blend bananas with milk to make a smoothie.

香蕉.zh: 虽然香蕉很便宜，但营养价值很高。
香蕉.en: Although bananas are cheap, their nutritional value is high.

服务员.zh: 那位服务员的服务态度非常好。
服务员.en: That waiter's service attitude is very good.
The waiter served the dishes quickly.

服务员.zh: 如果你不满意，可以叫服务员过来。
服务员.en: If you're not satisfied, you can call the waiter over.

服务员.zh: 因为客人太多，服务员忙得没时间休息。
服务员.en: Because there were too many customers, the waiter was too busy to rest.

秋.zh: 秋是北京最美的季节，很多人来玩。
秋.en: Autumn is the most beautiful season in Beijing, many people come to visit.

秋.zh: 每年到了秋，我都会去爬山看红叶。
秋.en: Every year when autumn arrives, I go hiking to see red leaves.

秋.zh: 虽然秋来了，气温下降，但风景非常迷人。
秋.en: Although autumn has come and the temperature drops, the scenery is very charming.

大衣.zh: 今天太冷了，出门记得穿大衣。
大衣.en: It's too cold today, remember to wear an overcoat when you go out.

大衣.zh: 她的大衣是黑色的，看起来很时尚。
大衣.en: Her overcoat is black, looks very fashionable.

大衣.zh: 因为外面下雪了，所以我穿了一件厚大衣。
大衣.en: Because it's snowing outside, I wore a thick overcoat.

发烧.zh: 他发烧到三十九度，需要去医院。
发烧.en: He has a fever of 39 degrees, needs to go to the hospital.
Drink more water when you have a fever.

发烧.zh: 如果你发烧了，最好在家休息几天。
发烧.en: If you have a fever, you'd better rest at home for a few days.

发烧.zh: 因为昨晚着凉了，今天早上起来就发烧。
发烧.en: Because I caught a cold last night, I had a fever when I woke up this morning.

全场.zh: 他投了一个三分球，全场都欢呼起来。
全场.en: He made a three-pointer, and the whole crowd cheered.
The whole store is on sale.

全场.zh: 这家超市全场商品打八折。
全场.en: This supermarket has a 20% discount on all items.

全场.zh: 虽然比赛输了，但全场观众都为运动员鼓掌。
全场.en: Although the game was lost, the entire audience applauded for the athletes.

箱子.zh: 我把行李都放在一个大箱子里了。
箱子.en: I put all the luggage in a big suitcase.

箱子.zh: 搬家的时候，我用了好几个箱子装书。
箱子.en: When moving, I used several boxes to pack books.

箱子.zh: 因为箱子太小了，装不下这么多东西。
箱子.en: Because the box is too small, it can't hold so many things.

学期.zh: 下学期我打算选一门历史课。
学期.en: Next semester I plan to take a history class.

学期.zh: 学期刚开始，我们就有了很多作业。
学期.en: The semester just started, and we already have a lot of homework.

学期.zh: 你每个学期都修多少学分？
学期.en: How many credits do you take each semester?

学期.zh: 学期末的时候，大家都要准备考试。
学期.en: At the end of the semester, everyone has to prepare for exams.

路边.en: There is a snack shop by the roadside.
He parked the car on the side of the road.

路边.zh: 路边卖水果的阿姨人很好。
路边.en: The auntie selling fruit by the roadside is very nice.

路边.zh: 我们沿着路边走，看到了很多花。
路边.en: We walked along the roadside and saw many flowers.
Be careful, there's a dog by the roadside.

难题.en: This problem is a tough one.

难题.zh: 怎么解决这个难题，大家想了很久。
难题.en: Everyone thought for a long time about how to solve this difficult problem.

难题.zh: 工作上的难题有时候需要跟同事商量。
难题.en: Sometimes you need to discuss work problems with colleagues.

难题.zh: 这道数学难题我花了两个小时才做出来。
难题.en: It took me two hours to solve this hard math problem.

共有.en: We have three choices in total.
This residential area has ten buildings in total.
The whole class has thirty students in total.

共有.zh: 这两个国家共有一条边界。
共有.en: These two countries share a common border.

共有.zh: 他共有五个兄弟姐妹，但都不住在一起。
共有.en: He has five siblings in total, but they don't live together.

干吗.en: Why isn't he answering the phone?

干吗.zh: 你干吗要买这么贵的东西？
干吗.en: Why do you want to buy such expensive things?

干吗.zh: 你干吗不去试试？也许能成功。
干吗.en: Why don't you give it a try? Maybe you'll succeed.

干吗.zh: 她干吗总是迟到，没人知道原因。
干吗.en: Why does she always arrive late? No one knows the reason.

伞.en: I forgot to bring an umbrella.
It's raining, hurry up and open your umbrella!

伞.zh: 他借给我一把伞，我很感谢他。
伞.en: He lent me an umbrella, and I was very grateful to him.

伞.zh: 出门前记得带伞，天气预报说下午有雨。
伞.en: Remember to bring an umbrella before going out; the weather forecast says it will rain in the afternoon.

放假.zh: 放假了，你打算去哪儿玩？
放假.en: The holiday has started, where do you plan to go?

放假.zh: 放假的时候，我喜欢在家睡觉。
放假.en: During the holidays, I like to sleep at home.

放假.zh: 春节放假七天，我们可以回老家。
放假.en: The Spring Festival holiday is seven days, so we can go back to our hometown.

放假.zh: 虽然放假了，但他还在加班。
放假.en: Even though the holiday has started, he is still working overtime.

路口.en: I'll wait for you at the intersection.
Turn right at the next intersection and you'll be there.
This intersection often has traffic jams.

路口.zh: 走到下一个路口，就能看到银行。
路口.en: Walk to the next intersection and you'll see the bank.

路口.zh: 你到了路口给我打个电话，我去接你。
路口.en: Give me a call when you reach the intersection, and I'll come to pick you up.

有名.en: This hotpot restaurant is very famous.

有名.zh: 北京烤鸭在全世界都很有名。
有名.en: Peking duck is famous all over the world.

有名.zh: 这个景点很有名，但是门票太贵了。
有名.en: This scenic spot is very famous, but the ticket price is too expensive.

有名.zh: 她因为唱了一首歌变得很有名。
有名.en: She became very famous because she sang a song.

打扫.en: I need to do some cleaning on the weekend.

打扫.zh: 打扫完厨房，记得把垃圾扔掉。
打扫.en: After cleaning the kitchen, remember to take out the trash.

打扫.zh: 他每天都会打扫自己的办公室。
打扫.en: He cleans his own office every day.

打扫.zh: 我们轮流打扫客厅，这样比较公平。
打扫.en: We take turns cleaning the living room, which is fairer.

东北.zh: 东北冬天很冷，不过雪景很美。
东北.en: Winter in the northeast is very cold, but the snow scenery is beautiful.

东北.zh: 我特别喜欢吃东北的锅包肉。
东北.en: I especially like eating northeast-style sweet and sour pork.

东北.zh: 他去年去东北旅游了，拍了很多照片。
东北.en: He traveled to the northeast last year and took many photos.

东北.zh: 东北人说话很有意思，我朋友就是东北的。
东北.en: Northeastern people speak in a very interesting way; my friend is from the northeast.

中部.zh: 中国的中部地区很发达。
中部.en: The central region of China is very developed.

中部.zh: 我们学校在中部，离市区不远。
中部.en: Our school is in the central area, not far from the city center.

中部.zh: 这座山的中部有个小寺庙。
中部.en: There is a small temple in the middle of this mountain.

中部.zh: 如果你去中国中部旅游，可以去看看武汉。
中部.en: If you travel to central China, you can go see Wuhan.

中部.zh: 我住在城市的中部，上班很方便。
中部.en: I live in the central part of the city, so commuting is very convenient.

认出.en: I recognized him at a glance.

认出.zh: 虽然多年没见，我还是认出了她。
认出.en: Even though we hadn't seen each other for years, I still recognized her.

认出.zh: 你能认出这是谁的字吗？
认出.en: Can you recognize whose handwriting this is?

认出.zh: 她换了发型，我差点没认出来。
认出.en: She changed her hairstyle; I almost didn't recognize her.

认出.zh: 在人群中，我认出了那个穿红衣服的人。
认出.en: In the crowd, I recognized the person wearing red clothes.

可乐.en: I want to drink a glass of cola.

可乐.zh: 我不太爱喝可乐，因为太甜了。
可乐.en: I don't really like drinking cola because it's too sweet.

可乐.zh: 他每次吃饭都要点一瓶可乐。
可乐.en: Every time he eats, he orders a bottle of cola.
Do you drink cola or Sprite?

瓶子.en: This bottle is made of glass.
Please throw the bottle into the trash can.

瓶子.zh: 我买了一个新的水瓶，瓶子很好看。
瓶子.en: I bought a new water bottle; the bottle looks very nice.

瓶子.zh: 瓶子里的水已经不多了。
瓶子.en: There isn't much water left in the bottle.

瓶子.zh: 他把瓶子洗干净后用来装酱油。
瓶子.en: He washed the bottle clean and then used it to hold soy sauce.

复习.en: There's an exam tomorrow, so I need to review tonight.

复习.zh: 我每天都会复习一遍笔记。
复习.en: I review my notes once every day.

复习.zh: 复习的时候最好关掉手机。
复习.en: It's best to turn off your phone when reviewing.

复习.zh: 如果你不好好复习，考试可能会不及格。
复习.en: If you don't review properly, you might fail the exam.

复习.zh: 这周末我们一起去图书馆复习吧。
复习.en: Let's go to the library together this weekend to review.

歌迷.en: I am a fan of Jay Chou.

歌迷.zh: 很多歌迷在演唱会门口排队。
歌迷.en: Many fans are lining up at the concert entrance.

歌迷.zh: 作为一个歌迷，我收藏了他的所有专辑。
歌迷.en: As a fan, I have collected all his albums.

歌迷.zh: 歌迷们激动得大喊大叫。
歌迷.en: The fans were so excited they shouted and yelled.

歌迷.zh: 她是个疯狂的歌迷，每场演出都去。
歌迷.en: She is a crazy fan; she goes to every performance.

小区.en: I live in this residential community.

小区.zh: 我们小区环境很好，有游泳池。
小区.en: Our community has a great environment and has a swimming pool.

小区.zh: 小区门口有保安，很安全。
小区.en: There is a security guard at the community entrance, so it's very safe.

小区.zh: 这个小区虽然旧了一点，但是邻居都很好。
小区.en: Although this community is a bit old, the neighbors are all very nice.

小区.zh: 新小区离地铁站很近，走路五分钟。
小区.en: The new community is very close to the subway station, just a five-minute walk.

秋天.en: Autumn has arrived; the weather has turned cooler.

秋天.zh: 我特别喜欢秋天的红叶。
秋天.en: I really like the red leaves of autumn.

秋天.zh: 秋天是丰收的季节，很多水果都熟了。
秋天.en: Autumn is the harvest season; many fruits are ripe.

秋天.zh: 去年秋天我们去了香山看红叶。
秋天.en: Last autumn we went to Fragrant Hills to see the red leaves.

秋天.zh: 秋天一到，我就想喝热茶。
秋天.en: As soon as autumn comes, I want to drink hot tea.

解开.en: Please help me untie this knot.

解开.zh: 经过思考，我终于解开了这个谜题。
解开.en: After thinking it over, I finally solved this puzzle.
She untied her scarf and revealed a smile.

熊猫.zh: 我在动物园看到了两只熊猫。
熊猫.en: I saw two pandas at the zoo.

熊猫.zh: 熊猫是中国的国宝，大家都喜欢它。
熊猫.en: Pandas are China's national treasure, everyone likes them.

熊猫.zh: 这只小熊猫趴在地上睡觉，真可爱。
熊猫.en: This little panda is lying on the ground sleeping, so cute.

熊猫.zh: 虽然熊猫看起来笨笨的，但它爬树很厉害。
熊猫.en: Although pandas look clumsy, they are great at climbing trees.

护照.zh: 出国前一定要检查护照有效期。
护照.en: Be sure to check the validity of your passport before going abroad.

护照.zh: 他把护照忘在酒店里，差点误了飞机。
护照.en: He left his passport in the hotel and almost missed the flight.

护照.zh: 办新护照需要带身份证和照片。
护照.en: To get a new passport you need to bring your ID and photos.

护照.zh: 虽然护照丢了很麻烦，但可以补办。
护照.en: Although losing your passport is troublesome, you can get a replacement.

耳机.zh: 戴上耳机听音乐，不打扰别人。
耳机.en: Put on earphones to listen to music without disturbing others.

耳机.zh: 他在地铁上一直戴着耳机，没听见报站。
耳机.en: He was wearing earphones on the subway and didn't hear the announcement.

耳机.zh: 这款无线耳机音质很好，价格也不贵。
耳机.en: These wireless earphones have good sound quality and are not expensive.

耳机.zh: 因为耳机线缠在一起了，我花了好几分钟才解开。
耳机.en: Because the earphone cord was tangled, it took me a few minutes to untie it.

初中.en: He is starting middle school this year.
I went to middle school in Beijing.

初中.zh: 初中三年，我交到了最好的朋友。
初中.en: During three years of middle school, I made my best friends.

初中.zh: 虽然初中功课变多了，但课外活动也更有趣。
初中.en: Although middle school homework increased, extracurricular activities became more interesting too.

初中.zh: 她初中毕业后去了一所艺术高中。
初中.en: After graduating from middle school, she went to an art high school.

放学.zh: 放学后一起去打篮球吧。
放学.en: Let's go play basketball after school.

放学.zh: 今天放学特别早，因为老师要开会。
放学.en: School ended especially early today because the teachers had a meeting.

放学.zh: 妈妈每天放学都准时在校门口接我。
放学.en: Mom picks me up at the school gate on time every day after school.

放学.zh: 虽然放学了，但他还在教室里做作业。
放学.en: Although school was over, he was still doing homework in the classroom.

画家.zh: 这位画家的作品在美术馆展览。
画家.en: This painter's works are exhibited in the art museum.

画家.zh: 画家用了一整年时间完成这幅画。
画家.en: The painter spent a whole year completing this painting.

画家.zh: 我小时候梦想当一名画家，后来学了设计。
画家.en: When I was little, I dreamed of becoming a painter, but later I studied design.

画家.zh: 虽然画家生活很自由，但收入不太稳定。
画家.en: Although a painter's life is very free, the income is not very stable.

西南.en: My home is in the southwest.

西南.zh: 西南地区有很多美味的小吃。
西南.en: The southwest region has many delicious snacks.

西南.zh: 飞机向西南方向飞行了两个小时。
西南.en: The plane flew southwest for two hours.

西南.zh: 他打算去西南大学读研究生。
西南.en: He plans to go to Southwest University for graduate school.

西南.zh: 虽然西南部气候潮湿，但风景特别美。
西南.en: Although the southwest has a humid climate, the scenery is especially beautiful.

西北.zh: 他来自西北的一个小城市。
西北.en: He comes from a small city in the northwest.

西北.zh: 西北地区的羊肉泡馍非常有名。
西北.en: The mutton stew with bread in the northwest region is very famous.

西北.zh: 今年暑假我们一家去了西北旅游。
西北.en: This summer vacation our family traveled to the northwest.

西北.zh: 虽然西北比较干燥，但那里的星空特别清晰。
西北.en: Although the northwest is relatively dry, the starry sky there is especially clear.

卫生间.zh: 这个商场的卫生间很干净。
卫生间.en: The restroom in this mall is very clean.

卫生间.zh: 他进了卫生间才发现没带纸。
卫生间.en: He went into the bathroom and only then realized he didn't bring toilet paper.

卫生间.zh: 虽然卫生间不大，但布局很合理。
卫生间.en: Although the bathroom is small, the layout is very reasonable.

出院.en: He will be discharged from the hospital tomorrow.

出院.zh: 医生说我下周可以出院了。
出院.en: The doctor said I can be discharged next week.

出院.zh: 出院后要注意休息，别太累。
出院.en: After being discharged, you need to rest and not get too tired.

出院.zh: 她出院那天，家里人都在门口等她。
出院.en: On the day she was discharged, her family was waiting for her at the door.

出院.zh: 虽然出院了，但还是要按时复查。
出院.en: Although he was discharged, he still needs to have regular check-ups.

半天.en: I waited for a long time.
He looked for a long time but still didn't understand.

半天.zh: 因为路上堵车，我迟到了半天。
半天.en: Because of the traffic jam, I was late for a long time.

半天.zh: 这部电影演了半天才结束。
半天.en: This movie went on for half a day before ending.

半天.zh: 我找了半天也没找到钥匙。
半天.en: I searched for a long time but didn't find the keys.

体育馆.en: We go to the gym to play ball.

体育馆.zh: 这个体育馆可以容纳五千人。
体育馆.en: This gym can hold five thousand people.

体育馆.zh: 虽然体育馆很大，但今天人特别多。
体育馆.en: Although the gym is big, there are especially many people today.

体育馆.zh: 他每天下午都去体育馆锻炼。
体育馆.en: He goes to the gym to exercise every afternoon.

体育馆.zh: 体育馆离我家不远，走路就能到。
体育馆.en: The gym is not far from my home; I can walk there.

上衣.zh: 你买的上衣颜色真好看。
上衣.en: The color of the shirt you bought is really nice.

上衣.zh: 如果你觉得冷，就穿件上衣吧。
上衣.en: If you feel cold, just put on a shirt.

上衣.zh: 今天出门忘穿上衣了，好尴尬。
上衣.en: I forgot to wear a shirt when I went out today; so embarrassing.

上衣.zh: 这件上衣是昨天在商场打折买的。
上衣.en: I bought this shirt on sale at the mall yesterday.

建成.en: The new building has been completed.

建成.zh: 这座桥花了一年才建成。
建成.en: This bridge took a year to build.

建成.zh: 因为资金问题，这个项目到现在还没建成。
建成.en: Due to funding issues, this project hasn't been completed yet.

建成.zh: 新机场建成后，出行方便多了。
建成.en: After the new airport was built, travel became much more convenient.

建成.zh: 他们计划在年底前把图书馆建成。
建成.en: They plan to complete the library by the end of the year.

菜单.zh: 这家餐厅的菜单有很多选择。
菜单.en: This restaurant's menu has many options.

菜单.zh: 我们一边看菜单一边等朋友。
菜单.en: We looked at the menu while waiting for our friend.

菜单.zh: 服务员，麻烦拿一下菜单。
菜单.en: Waiter, could you please bring the menu?

菜单.zh: 今天的菜单上没有我喜欢的菜。
菜单.en: Today's menu doesn't have any dishes I like.

一方面.en: On the one hand, we need to save money.

一方面.zh: 一方面工作忙，另一方面也要照顾家庭。
一方面.en: On the one hand, work is busy; on the other hand, I also need to take care of my family.

一方面.zh: 他一方面想辞职，一方面又担心找不到新工作。
一方面.en: On the one hand, he wants to quit; on the other hand, he worries about not finding a new job.

一方面.zh: 一方面要锻炼身体，一方面还要注意饮食。
一方面.en: On the one hand, you need to exercise; on the other hand, you also need to watch your diet.

一方面.zh: 这个决定一方面对公司有利，一方面也有风险。
一方面.en: This decision is beneficial to the company on the one hand, but also carries risks on the other.

年级.en: My younger brother is in third grade.

年级.zh: 虽然我们年级不同，但经常一起玩。
年级.en: Although we are in different grades, we often play together.

年级.zh: 这个年级的学生明天有考试。
年级.en: The students in this grade have an exam tomorrow.

年级.zh: 他因为成绩好跳了一年级。
年级.en: He skipped a grade because of his good grades.

搬家.zh: 搬家的时候丢了很多东西。
搬家.en: I lost a lot of things when moving.

搬家.zh: 因为房租太贵，我们决定搬家。
搬家.en: Because the rent is too expensive, we decided to move.

搬家.zh: 搬家真麻烦，要打包很多东西。
搬家.en: Moving is such a hassle; you have to pack a lot of stuff.

笔记.en: You should take notes carefully in class.

笔记.zh: 我把笔记整理好，然后发给你。
笔记.en: I'll organize my notes and then send them to you.

笔记.zh: 他的笔记记得很详细，复习很有用。
笔记.en: His notes are very detailed and useful for review.

外地.zh: 去外地工作要适应新环境。
外地.en: Working in another city requires adapting to a new environment.

外地.zh: 虽然我在外地生活，但经常回家。
外地.en: Although I live in another city, I often go home.

外地.zh: 外地来的朋友需要办暂住证。
外地.en: Friends from other cities need to apply for a temporary residence permit.

外地.zh: 这家店的外地顾客越来越多。
外地.en: This shop has more and more customers from other places.

休假.en: I have three days off next week.

休假.zh: 休假的时候我想去海边走走。
休假.en: During the vacation, I want to take a walk by the sea.

休假.zh: 因为工作太累，所以决定休假一个月。
休假.en: Because work was too tiring, I decided to take a month off.

休假.zh: 你休假期间能帮我收一下快递吗？
休假.en: Can you help me receive the package while you're on leave?

休假.zh: 这次休假我打算好好休息一下。
休假.en: This vacation I plan to rest well.

前天.en: The day before yesterday I went to the supermarket.

前天.zh: 前天晚上我们一起看了电影。
前天.en: The night before yesterday we watched a movie together.

前天.zh: 他前天给我发了消息，但我没看到。
前天.en: He sent me a message the day before yesterday, but I didn't see it.

前天.zh: 前天是她的生日，我送了一束花。
前天.en: The day before yesterday was her birthday, and I gave her a bouquet of flowers.

前天.zh: 前天你说要来的，怎么没来？
前天.en: You said you would come the day before yesterday, why didn't you?

斤.zh: 我买了两斤苹果和一斤橘子。
斤.en: I bought two jin of apples and one jin of oranges.
How much is one jin of pork?

斤.zh: 他每天吃一斤米饭，太多了。
斤.en: He eats one jin of rice every day, that's too much.

斤.zh: 虽然只买了一斤草莓，但够吃了。
斤.en: Although I only bought one jin of strawberries, it's enough to eat.

世界杯.en: Do you like watching the World Cup?

世界杯.zh: 世界杯决赛那晚我熬夜了。
世界杯.en: I stayed up late the night of the World Cup final.

世界杯.zh: 今年世界杯在卡塔尔举行。
世界杯.en: This year's World Cup is held in Qatar.

世界杯.zh: 因为世界杯，很多酒吧都爆满。
世界杯.en: Because of the World Cup, many bars are packed.

世界杯.zh: 他为了看世界杯，请假了一周。
世界杯.en: He took a week off to watch the World Cup.

过节.zh: 过节的时候家里很热闹。
过节.en: The house is very lively during the holidays.
Where do you plan to go for the holiday?

过节.zh: 过节我们都会回老家团聚。
过节.en: We always go back to our hometown for family reunions during the holidays.

过节.zh: 因为过节，商店都关门了。
过节.en: Because of the holiday, all the shops are closed.

过节.zh: 过节吃饺子是我们的传统。
过节.en: Eating dumplings during the holiday is our tradition.

变为.en: The light rain turned into heavy rain.

变为.zh: 从朋友变为恋人不容易。
变为.en: It's not easy to go from friends to lovers.

变为.zh: 他最终变为了一名医生。
因为努力，梦想变为了现实。
变为.en: Because of hard work, the dream became reality.

变为.zh: 心情从不好变为了很好。
变为.en: My mood changed from bad to great.

邮箱.zh: 请把文件发到公司邮箱。
邮箱.en: Please send the file to the company email.

邮箱.zh: 我忘记邮箱密码了，怎么办？
邮箱.en: I forgot my email password, what should I do?

邮箱.zh: 因为垃圾邮件太多，我换了新邮箱。
邮箱.en: Because there was too much spam, I switched to a new email.

晚点.en: The flight is delayed by one hour.

晚点.zh: 因为天气不好，航班晚点了。
晚点.en: Because of bad weather, the flight was delayed.

晚点.zh: 晚点的话我会提前告诉你。
晚点.en: If it's delayed, I'll let you know in advance.

晚点.zh: 这次晚点让我错过了会议。
晚点.en: This delay made me miss the meeting.

面条.en: This bowl of noodles is too salty.

面条.zh: 他要了一碗面条，加鸡蛋。
面条.en: He ordered a bowl of noodles with an egg.
The noodles my mom makes are the most delicious.

面条.zh: 因为时间紧，我只煮了方便面条。
面条.en: Because I was short on time, I only cooked instant noodles.

照相.en: Don't close your eyes when taking a photo.
I went to the park yesterday to take photos.

照相.zh: 因为光线好，我们照相很顺利。
照相.en: Because the lighting was good, we took photos smoothly.
Her photography skills are very good.

动物园.en: We go to the zoo to see pandas.

动物园.zh: 周末动物园人特别多，最好早点去。
动物园.en: The zoo is especially crowded on weekends, so it's best to go early.

动物园.zh: 你上次去动物园是什么时候？
动物园.en: When was the last time you went to the zoo?

动物园.zh: 小孩子都喜欢去动物园，因为能看到很多动物。
动物园.en: Children all like going to the zoo because they can see many animals.

动物园.zh: 动物园里的老虎在睡觉。
动物园.en: The tiger in the zoo is sleeping.

盘子.zh: 你把盘子端到餐桌上去吧。
盘子.en: Take the plate to the dining table.

盘子.zh: 吃完饭记得把盘子洗干净。
盘子.en: Remember to wash the plates clean after eating.

盘子.zh: 超市里的盘子打折，我买了五个。
盘子.en: Plates at the supermarket were on sale, so I bought five.

盘子.zh: 盘子碎了，要小心别割到手。
盘子.en: The plate broke; be careful not to cut your hand.

草地.en: Let's have a picnic on the grass.

草地.zh: 雨后的草地特别绿，空气也很新鲜。
草地.en: After the rain, the grass is especially green and the air is fresh too.

草地.zh: 草地上有很多小朋友在放风筝。
草地.en: There are many children flying kites on the grass.

草地.zh: 公园里的草地需要定期修剪。
草地.en: The grass in the park needs regular trimming.

西瓜.en: I love eating watermelon the most in summer.
The watermelon is cut; come and eat.

西瓜.zh: 我们买了一个大西瓜，大家一起分着吃。
西瓜.en: We bought a big watermelon and shared it among everyone.

西瓜.zh: 冰箱里还有半个西瓜，你吃不吃？
西瓜.en: There's half a watermelon left in the fridge; do you want to eat it?

铅笔.zh: 铅笔字写错了可以用橡皮擦掉。
铅笔.en: If you write wrong in pencil, you can erase it with an eraser.

铅笔.zh: 我小时候喜欢用铅笔画画，尤其是素描。
铅笔.en: When I was little, I liked drawing with pencils, especially sketches.

铅笔.zh: 商店里的铅笔种类很多，有2B、HB等等。
铅笔.en: There are many kinds of pencils in the store, like 2B, HB, and so on.

认得.zh: 我不认得路，你能带我去吗？
认得.en: I don't know the way; can you take me there?

认得.zh: 她是我同学，我当然认得。
认得.en: She is my classmate; of course I know her.

认得.zh: 虽然多年不见，但我还认得他的声音。
认得.en: Although we haven't seen each other for years, I still recognize his voice.

认得.zh: 新来的老师你认得不认得？
认得.en: Do you know the new teacher or not?

关机.zh: 手机没电了，自动关机了。
关机.en: The phone battery died, and it shut down automatically.
Please turn off your phone on the plane.

关机.zh: 电脑死机了，只能强制关机。
关机.en: The computer froze; I had to force shut it down.

关机.zh: 睡觉前记得把手机关机，不然半夜会响。
关机.en: Remember to turn off your phone before sleeping, or it will ring in the middle of the night.

关机.zh: 我关机了，有事请发短信。
关机.en: I've turned off my phone; if something comes up, please send a text.

推开.zh: 他用力推开窗户，透透气。
推开.en: He pushed the window open forcefully to get some air.
Don't push me away; I want to help you.

推开.zh: 他推开人群，挤到前面去。
推开.en: He pushed through the crowd and squeezed to the front.

推开.zh: 风太大，一推开门就被吹倒了。
推开.en: The wind was so strong that as soon as I pushed the door open, I was knocked over.

短裤.en: I like wearing shorts in summer.

短裤.zh: 运动的时候穿短裤比较方便。
短裤.en: It's more convenient to wear shorts when exercising.

短裤.zh: 他穿着短裤和拖鞋就出门了。
短裤.en: He went out wearing shorts and slippers.

短裤.zh: 商场里短裤正在打折，我买了两条。
短裤.en: Shorts are on sale at the mall, so I bought two pairs.

后天.en: The day after tomorrow is Friday.
Let's meet the day after tomorrow.
I have an exam the day after tomorrow.

后天.zh: 今天先休息，后天再继续工作。
后天.en: Rest today, and continue working the day after tomorrow.

后天.zh: 后天就是春节了，你准备怎么过？
后天.en: The day after tomorrow is Chinese New Year; how do you plan to spend it?

渴.zh: 今天太热了，我渴得不行。
渴.en: Today is so hot, I'm unbearably thirsty.

渴.zh: 如果你渴了，冰箱里有水。
渴.en: If you're thirsty, there's water in the fridge.

渴.zh: 跑完步以后，我觉得特别渴。
渴.en: After running, I feel very thirsty.

长城.en: Let's go climb the Great Wall.

长城.zh: 来北京一定要去看看长城。
长城.en: When coming to Beijing, you must go see the Great Wall.

长城.zh: 长城是中国的名胜古迹。
长城.en: The Great Wall is a famous historical site in China.

长城.zh: 虽然爬长城很累，但是风景很美。
长城.en: Although climbing the Great Wall is tiring, the scenery is beautiful.
The Great Wall is very long.

常用.zh: 微信是中国人的常用聊天软件。
常用.en: WeChat is a commonly used messaging app for Chinese people.

常用.zh: 这个药是常用的感冒药。
常用.en: This medicine is a commonly used cold medicine.

常用.zh: 因为手机很常用，所以记得带充电器。
常用.en: Because phones are commonly used, remember to bring a charger.
I don't commonly use credit cards.

电子邮件.zh: 我每天都会查收电子邮件。
电子邮件.en: I check my email every day.

电子邮件.zh: 你用电子邮件联系他吧。
如果你有问题，可以发电子邮件问老师。
电子邮件.en: If you have questions, you can email the teacher.

请客.zh: 这次我来请客，你别跟我抢。
请客.en: This time let me treat, don't fight me for it.
Next time it's your birthday, I'll treat.

请客.zh: 因为升职了，所以想请大家吃饭请客。
请客.en: Because I got promoted, I want to treat everyone to dinner.

请假.en: I need to ask for leave.

请假.zh: 明天我要去医院，所以得请假。
请假.en: Tomorrow I have to go to the hospital, so I need to take leave.
The leave application process is very simple.

请假.zh: 如果你不舒服，就请假休息一天吧。
请假.en: If you don't feel well, just take a day off.

衬衣.zh: 今天面试，我穿了一件白衬衣。
衬衣.en: For today's interview, I wore a white shirt.

衬衣.zh: 虽然衬衣好看，但是有点紧。
衬衣.en: Although the shirt looks good, it's a bit tight.

洗衣机.zh: 我用洗衣机洗衣服，很方便。
洗衣机.en: I use the washing machine to wash clothes, very convenient.

洗衣机.zh: 把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
洗衣机.en: Put the dirty clothes into the washing machine.

洗衣机.zh: 因为洗衣机太小，所以一次洗不了太多。
洗衣机.en: Because the washing machine is too small, it can't wash too much at once.

句子.zh: 老师让我们造一个句子。
句子.en: The teacher asked us to make a sentence.

句子.zh: 虽然句子很短，但是意思很清楚。
句子.en: Although the sentence is short, the meaning is very clear.

照相机.zh: 去旅行的时候，别忘了带照相机。
照相机.en: When traveling, don't forget to bring a camera.

照相机.zh: 这部照相机拍的照片很清楚。
照相机.en: The photos taken by this camera are very clear.

照相机.zh: 因为手机拍照很好，所以我很少用照相机。
照相机.en: Because the phone takes good photos, I rarely use the camera.

班级.zh: 因为班级活动，我认识了几个新朋友。
班级.en: Because of class activities, I met several new friends.

班级.zh: 这个班级的学习氛围很好。
班级.en: The learning atmosphere in this class is very good.

班级.zh: 虽然我们班级不大，但是大家都很团结。
班级.en: Although our class is not big, everyone is very united.

筷子.zh: 在中国吃面条，最好用筷子，别用叉子。
筷子.en: When eating noodles in China, it's best to use chopsticks, not a fork.
Give me a pair of chopsticks.

筷子.zh: 他学了好久才学会用筷子吃饭。
筷子.en: He studied for a long time before learning to eat with chopsticks.

东南.en: My home is on the southeast side.

东南.zh: 台风正在往东南方向移动。
东南沿海的经济发展很快。
东南.en: The economy on the southeast coast is developing quickly.
Can you distinguish east, south, west, north?

东南.zh: 从这个路口往东南走五百米就到了。
东南.en: From this intersection, go southeast for 500 meters and you'll arrive.

难看.zh: 他今天的发型看起来有点难看。
难看.en: His hairstyle today looks a bit ugly.

难看.zh: 虽然这个包有点难看，但是很实用。
难看.en: Although this bag is a bit ugly, it's very practical.

难看.zh: 别笑我，我知道自己难看。
难看.en: Don't laugh at me, I know I look ugly.

难看.zh: 这个颜色搭配在一起感觉很难看。
难看.en: This color combination feels ugly together.

外语.en: How many foreign languages can you speak?

外语.zh: 学习外语需要多听多说多练习。
外语.en: Learning a foreign language requires more listening, speaking, and practice.
His foreign language level is very high.

外语.zh: 为了找工作，他每天都在学外语。
外语.en: In order to find a job, he studies foreign languages every day.

一块儿.zh: 周末我们一块儿去看电影好不好？
一块儿.en: Let's go watch a movie together on the weekend, okay?

一块儿.zh: 他们俩总是一块儿吃饭。
一块儿.en: The two of them always eat together.

一块儿.zh: 既然顺路，我们就一块儿走回家吧。
一块儿.en: Since we're going the same way, let's walk home together.

大使馆.zh: 如果护照丢了，要去大使馆补办。
大使馆.en: If you lose your passport, you need to go to the embassy to get a replacement.
He works at the Chinese embassy.
Please contact the embassy as soon as possible.

大使馆.zh: 大使馆的工作人员会帮我们解决问题。
大使馆.en: The embassy staff will help us solve the problem.

感兴趣.zh: 我对中国文化很感兴趣，所以来中国留学。
感兴趣.en: I am very interested in Chinese culture, so I came to study in China.
He is not interested in music.
I am interested in this activity.

感兴趣.zh: 如果你对历史感兴趣，可以去参观博物馆。
感兴趣.en: If you are interested in history, you can visit the museum.

分组.zh: 这次活动需要提前分组。
分组.en: This activity requires grouping in advance.

分组.zh: 分组的时候，记得每个小组要有不同的人。
分组.en: When grouping, remember each group should have different people.

运动会.zh: 他在学校的运动会上跑得最快。
运动会.en: He ran the fastest at the school sports meet.
The sports meet was postponed due to rain.
Are you participating in the sports meet?

运动会.zh: 运动会上有很多有趣的比赛项目。
运动会.en: There are many fun competition events at the sports meet.

开花.zh: 春天来了，花园里的花都开花了。
开花.en: Spring has come, all the flowers in the garden are blooming.

开花.zh: 我家的仙人掌终于开花了，我很开心。
开花.en: My cactus finally bloomed, I'm very happy.

开花.zh: 虽然这盆花很难养，但它今年开花了。
开花.en: Although this potted plant is hard to care for, it bloomed this year.

开花.zh: 等樱花开花的时候，我们一起去拍照吧。
开花.en: When the cherry blossoms bloom, let's go take photos together.

四季.zh: 我喜欢四季分明的城市。
四季.en: I like cities with distinct four seasons.

四季.zh: 因为这里四季如春，所以很多人来养老。
四季.en: Because it's spring-like all year round, many people come to retire.
Among the four seasons, I like autumn best.

四季.zh: 这个国家四季都很温暖，很少下雪。
四季.en: This country is warm in all four seasons, rarely snows.

代表团.zh: 我们学校派了一个代表团去北京。
代表团.en: Our school sent a delegation to Beijing.

代表团.zh: 如果代表团来了，我就去机场接他们。
代表团.en: If the delegation comes, I'll go pick them up at the airport.

代表团.zh: 这个代表团主要由学生组成。
代表团.en: This delegation is mainly composed of students.

代表团.zh: 代表团在会议上提出了很多建议。
代表团.en: The delegation put forward many suggestions at the meeting.

开机.en: The computer boots up too slowly.

开机.zh: 先开机，然后再输入密码。
开机.en: First turn on the device, then enter the password.

开机.zh: 我按了开机键，但没反应。
开机.en: I pressed the power button, but no response.

开机.zh: 新电视剧下周开机，演员还没定好。
开机.en: The new TV series starts filming next week, the cast hasn't been decided yet.

牙刷.zh: 你应该三个月换一次牙刷。
牙刷.en: You should replace your toothbrush every three months.

牙刷.zh: 因为牙刷太旧了，所以我买了一把新的。
牙刷.en: Because the toothbrush was too old, I bought a new one.

牙刷.zh: 酒店的牙刷质量不太好。
牙刷.en: The toothbrush quality at the hotel is not great.

牙刷.zh: 旅行时别忘了带牙刷和牙膏。
牙刷.en: Don't forget to bring a toothbrush and toothpaste when traveling.

课本.en: The content of this textbook is very interesting.

课本.zh: 虽然课本很厚，但我都看完了。
课本.en: Although the textbook is thick, I finished reading it.

课本.zh: 老师让我们把课本翻到第十页。
课本.en: The teacher told us to turn the textbook to page 10.

课本.zh: 这学期我们用的课本是新的版本。
课本.en: The textbook we use this semester is the new edition.

矿泉水.en: Give me a bottle of mineral water.

矿泉水.zh: 外面太热了，我想喝矿泉水。
矿泉水.en: It's so hot outside, I want to drink mineral water.

矿泉水.zh: 如果你渴了，冰箱里有矿泉水。
矿泉水.en: If you're thirsty, there's mineral water in the fridge.

矿泉水.zh: 这个牌子的矿泉水味道不错。
矿泉水.en: This brand of mineral water tastes good.

矿泉水.zh: 超市里的矿泉水比饮料便宜多了。
矿泉水.en: Mineral water in the supermarket is much cheaper than soft drinks.

做客.en: I went to his house as a guest.

做客.zh: 周末我们邀请朋友来家里做客。
做客.en: We invited friends over to our house this weekend.

做客.zh: 如果明天有空，我就去你家做客。
做客.en: If I'm free tomorrow, I'll come to your place as a guest.

做客.zh: 第一次去别人家做客，要带礼物。
做客.en: When visiting someone's home for the first time, bring a gift.

做客.zh: 在国外做客时要尊重当地的习惯。
做客.en: When being a guest abroad, respect local customs.

所长.en: The director is in a meeting.

所长.zh: 这个研究所的所长很有名。
所长.en: The director of this research institute is very famous.

所长.zh: 因为所长很忙，所以很难约到他。
所长.en: Because the director is very busy, it's hard to schedule a meeting with him.
Our director is on a business trip today.

所长.zh: 新所长上任后，做了很多改革。
所长.en: After the new director took office, he made many reforms.

票价.en: The ticket price is too expensive.

票价.zh: 这部电影票价只要三十块。
票价.en: The ticket price for this movie is only 30 yuan.

票价.zh: 因为票价便宜，所以很多人来看。
票价.en: Because the ticket price is cheap, many people come to see it.

票价.zh: 高铁票价会根据时间变化。
票价.en: High-speed rail ticket prices vary by time.

票价.zh: 演唱会票价从几百到几千不等。
票价.en: Concert ticket prices range from hundreds to thousands.

字典.en: I look up new words using a phone dictionary.

字典.zh: 因为字典太重了，所以我很少带它出门。
字典.en: Because the dictionary is too heavy, I rarely bring it out.

字典.zh: 你的字典能借我一下吗？我想查个词。
字典.en: Can I borrow your dictionary? I want to look up a word.

字典.zh: 虽然买了电子字典，但我还是喜欢用纸质的。
字典.en: Although I bought an electronic dictionary, I still prefer using a paper one.

有的是.en: Don't worry, there's plenty of time.

有的是.zh: 超市里水果有的是，不用着急买。
有的是.en: There's plenty of fruit in the supermarket, no need to rush to buy.

有的是.zh: 你缺钱吗？我这儿有的是，先借给你。
有的是.en: Are you short on money? I have plenty here, I'll lend you some first.

有的是.zh: 机会有的是，但你要自己把握。
有的是.en: There are plenty of opportunities, but you have to seize them yourself.

有的是.zh: 别担心座位，空位子有的是，我们慢慢找。
有的是.en: Don't worry about seats, there are plenty of empty seats, we'll find them slowly.

皮包.en: This leather bag is very expensive.

皮包.zh: 我的皮包被偷了，里面有很多重要的东西。
皮包.en: My leather bag was stolen, there were many important things inside.

皮包.zh: 她买了一个新皮包，颜色是黑色的。
皮包.en: She bought a new leather bag, the color is black.

皮包.zh: 因为皮包太大，所以我换了个小的。
皮包.en: Because the leather bag was too big, I switched to a small one.

皮包.zh: 你送我的那个皮包，我每天都用。
皮包.en: The leather bag you gave me, I use it every day.

工作日.zh: 工作日我一般六点起床。
工作日.en: I usually get up at six on workdays.

工作日.zh: 周末比工作日轻松多了，可以睡个懒觉。
工作日.en: Weekends are much more relaxing than workdays, you can sleep in.

工作日.zh: 因为工作日太忙，所以我只能周末去逛街。
工作日.en: Because workdays are too busy, I can only go shopping on weekends.

工作日.zh: 下个工作日我们要开一个重要的会议。
工作日.en: Next workday we have an important meeting.

连续剧.en: This TV series is very good.

连续剧.zh: 我每天追一部连续剧，已经看了二十集。
连续剧.en: I binge-watch a TV series every day, I've already watched twenty episodes.

连续剧.zh: 因为连续剧太长了，所以我决定跳着看。
连续剧.en: Because the TV series is too long, I decided to skip through it.

连续剧.zh: 你喜欢看韩国的连续剧还是中国的？
连续剧.en: Do you prefer watching Korean or Chinese TV series?

连续剧.zh: 这部连续剧的结局让我很失望，但前面还不错。
连续剧.en: The ending of this TV series disappointed me, but the beginning was okay.

黑板.en: The teacher writes on the blackboard.

黑板.zh: 黑板上的字太小了，我看不清楚。
黑板.en: The words on the blackboard are too small, I can't see them clearly.

黑板.zh: 值日生忘了擦黑板，老师有点生气。
黑板.en: The student on duty forgot to clean the blackboard, the teacher was a bit angry.

黑板.zh: 因为黑板反光，所以坐在角落的同学看不见。
黑板.en: Because the blackboard was reflective, the students in the corner couldn't see.

黑板.zh: 我们教室换了一块新黑板，写起来很顺滑。
黑板.en: Our classroom got a new blackboard, it's very smooth to write on.

留学.zh: 留学期间我学会了自己做饭。
留学.en: During my study abroad, I learned to cook for myself.

留学.zh: 如果你打算留学，一定要提前准备语言考试。
留学.en: If you plan to study abroad, you must prepare for the language exam in advance.

留学.zh: 他留学回来以后，英语进步了很多。
留学.en: After he came back from studying abroad, his English improved a lot.

留学.zh: 留学虽然辛苦，但是能见识到不同的文化。
留学.en: Studying abroad is hard, but you can experience different cultures.

勺子.en: You should use a spoon when drinking soup.

勺子.zh: 这把勺子太小了，不适合吃面条。
勺子.en: This spoon is too small, it's not suitable for eating noodles.

勺子.zh: 因为勺子掉地上了，所以我换了一把干净的。
勺子.en: Because the spoon fell on the floor, I switched to a clean one.

勺子.zh: 厨房里的勺子不够用了，我们再买几把吧。
勺子.en: We don't have enough spoons in the kitchen, let's buy a few more.

外卖.zh: 今晚不想做饭，我们叫外卖吧。
外卖.en: I don't feel like cooking tonight, let's order takeout.

外卖.zh: 因为下雨了，所以外卖送得比较慢。
外卖.en: Because it's raining, the takeout delivery is slower.

外卖.zh: 你经常吃外卖吗？对身体不太好哦。
外卖.en: Do you often eat takeout? It's not very good for your health.

外卖.zh: 这家店的外卖包装很精致，味道也不错。
外卖.en: The takeout packaging from this shop is very exquisite, and the taste is good too.

方便面.zh: 泡方便面只要三分钟，很方便。
方便面.en: It takes only three minutes to cook instant noodles, very convenient.

方便面.zh: 因为没时间做饭，所以我泡了一碗方便面。
方便面.en: Because I didn't have time to cook, I made a bowl of instant noodles.

方便面.zh: 方便面虽然好吃，但是不能经常吃。
方便面.en: Instant noodles are tasty, but you can't eat them too often.

方便面.zh: 出国的时候我带了几包方便面，想家了就泡一包。
方便面.en: When I went abroad, I brought a few packs of instant noodles; when I felt homesick, I'd make one.

行李箱.zh: 我昨天买了一个新的行李箱。
行李箱.en: I bought a new suitcase yesterday.

行李箱.zh: 因为行李箱太重了，所以我得托运。
行李箱.en: Because the suitcase was too heavy, I had to check it in.

行李箱.zh: 行李箱里装满了衣服和纪念品。
行李箱.en: The suitcase is full of clothes and souvenirs.

行李箱.zh: 出门前别忘了检查行李箱的轮子。
行李箱.en: Don't forget to check the wheels of the suitcase before you leave.

白菜.en: We're having cabbage stewed with vermicelli tonight.

白菜.zh: 白菜很便宜，一块钱一斤。
白菜.en: Cabbage is very cheap, one yuan per jin.

白菜.zh: 虽然我不太爱吃白菜，但是为了健康也得吃。
白菜.en: Although I don't really like cabbage, I have to eat it for health.
Wash the cabbage clean before cutting.

白菜.zh: 冬天的时候我家常买白菜储存起来。
白菜.en: In winter, my family often buys cabbages to store.

羽毛球.zh: 周末我经常和朋友一起打羽毛球。
羽毛球.en: I often play badminton with friends on weekends.

羽毛球.zh: 羽毛球拍坏了，我得换个新的。
羽毛球.en: The badminton racket is broken, I need to get a new one.

羽毛球.zh: 因为下雨了，所以我们改在室内打羽毛球。
羽毛球.en: Because it rained, we switched to playing badminton indoors.

难听.en: This song is really unpleasant to hear.

难听.zh: 别说那么难听的话，会伤人的。
难听.en: Don't say such nasty words, they can hurt people.

难听.zh: 虽然歌词写得不错，但是旋律太难听了。
难听.en: Although the lyrics are good, the melody is too unpleasant.

难听.zh: 她唱得再难听我也愿意听。
难听.en: Even if she sings terribly, I'm still willing to listen.

前年.en: I went to Beijing the year before last.
The winter the year before last was especially cold.

前年.zh: 前年她刚大学毕业，现在都当经理了。
前年.en: She just graduated from college the year before last, and now she's a manager.

前年.zh: 前年买的电脑现在还能用。
前年.en: The computer bought the year before last still works.

前年.zh: 前年我还没搬家呢，现在都住这儿两年了。
前年.en: I hadn't moved yet the year before last, and now I've lived here for two years.

词典.zh: 查词典可以知道这个词的意思。
词典.en: Looking up the dictionary can tell you the meaning of the word.

词典.zh: 手机上的词典比纸质词典方便多了。
词典.en: The dictionary on the phone is much more convenient than a paper dictionary.

词典.zh: 他每天都在背词典里的单词。
词典.en: He memorizes words from the dictionary every day.

词典.zh: 因为词典太旧了，所以我买了一本新的。
词典.en: Because the dictionary was too old, I bought a new one.

积极性.zh: 如果奖金多一点，员工的积极性就会更高。
积极性.en: If the bonus is a bit more, employees' enthusiasm will be higher.

积极性.zh: 老师表扬了几个同学，提高了全班的学习积极性。
积极性.en: The teacher praised a few students, boosting the whole class's learning enthusiasm.

积极性.zh: 虽然失败了，但是他的积极性一点没减。
积极性.en: Although he failed, his enthusiasm didn't diminish at all.

凉快.en: Open the window to cool down a bit.

凉快.zh: 比起夏天，我更喜欢凉快的秋天。
凉快.en: Compared to summer, I prefer the cool autumn.

凉快.zh: 这树下特别凉快，我们在这儿坐会儿吧。
凉快.en: It's especially cool under this tree, let's sit here for a while.

凉快.zh: 因为开了空调，房间里变得很凉快。
凉快.en: Because the air conditioner is on, the room has become very cool.

初一.en: Tomorrow is the first day of the lunar month.

初一.zh: 我初一就开始放寒假了。
初一.en: I started winter break from the first day of the lunar month.
His younger brother is in seventh grade this year.

初一.zh: 大年初一我们全家去拜年。
初一.en: On the first day of the New Year, our whole family goes to pay New Year's calls.

初一.zh: 初一那天庙里人特别多。
初一.en: On the first day of the lunar month, there were especially many people at the temple.

大熊猫.en: Giant pandas love to eat bamboo.

大熊猫.zh: 大熊猫是中国特有的动物。
大熊猫.en: Giant pandas are animals unique to China.

大熊猫.zh: 动物园里的大熊猫特别可爱。
大熊猫.en: The giant panda in the zoo is especially cute.

大熊猫.zh: 我们去看大熊猫的时候它正在睡觉。
大熊猫.en: When we went to see the giant panda, it was sleeping.

大熊猫.zh: 因为大熊猫数量很少，所以我们要好好保护它们。
大熊猫.en: Because there are very few giant pandas, we need to protect them well.

老头儿.en: That old man loves to play chess.

老头儿.zh: 小区里的老头儿们每天早晨都在一起打太极拳。
老头儿.en: The old men in the neighborhood do tai chi together every morning.

老头儿.zh: 我爷爷是个很有意思的老头儿，总爱讲笑话。
老头儿.en: My grandpa is a very interesting old man, always loves to tell jokes.

老头儿.zh: 虽然那个老头儿看起来很凶，其实心肠特别好。
老头儿.en: Although that old man looks fierce, he is actually very kind-hearted.
That old man walks very slowly.

划船.en: Let's go row a boat in the park.

划船.zh: 周末的时候，我和朋友在湖上划船，特别开心。
划船.en: On weekends, my friend and I row a boat on the lake, having a great time.

划船.zh: 划船是一项很锻炼身体的运动。
划船.en: Rowing is a great exercise for the body.

划船.zh: 因为天气很好，所以我们决定去划船。
划船.en: Because the weather was nice, we decided to go rowing.

雨衣.zh: 外面下雨了，快穿上雨衣再出门。
雨衣.en: It's raining outside, put on your raincoat before going out.

雨衣.zh: 这件雨衣是新的，防水效果很好。
雨衣.en: This raincoat is new and has great waterproof effect.

雨衣.zh: 虽然天气预报说没雨，但我还是带了雨衣以防万一。
雨衣.en: Although the weather forecast said no rain, I still brought a raincoat just in case.

留学生.en: He is an American international student.

留学生.zh: 我们学校有很多来自不同国家的留学生。
留学生.en: Our school has many international students from different countries.

留学生.zh: 留学生活让我学到了很多东西。
留学生.en: Studying abroad taught me a lot.

留学生.zh: 因为留学生要适应新环境，所以刚开始可能会觉得有点困难。
留学生.en: Because international students need to adapt to a new environment, they might find it a bit difficult at first.

留学生.zh: 留学生们常常一起聚餐。
留学生.en: International students often have dinner together.

交费.zh: 学校提醒我们尽快交费，不然会影响选课。
交费.en: The school reminds us to pay fees as soon as possible, otherwise it will affect course selection.

交费.zh: 如果你不按时交费，服务就会被停止。
交费.en: If you don't pay the fee on time, the service will be suspended.
Paying fees online is very convenient.

凉水.en: Don't drink cold water, it will give you a stomachache.

凉水.zh: 夏天的时候，我喜欢用凉水洗脸，感觉很舒服。
凉水.en: In summer, I like to wash my face with cold water, it feels very comfortable.
This glass of cold water is for you.

凉水.zh: 因为天气太热了，所以我喝了很多凉水。
凉水.en: Because the weather was too hot, I drank a lot of cold water.
Cold water is not suitable for making tea.

高铁.en: We take the high-speed rail to Beijing.

高铁.zh: 从上海到北京坐高铁只要四个多小时。
高铁.en: It takes only over four hours from Shanghai to Beijing by high-speed rail.

高铁.zh: 高铁票最好提前在网上买。
高铁.en: It's best to buy high-speed rail tickets online in advance.

高铁.zh: 虽然高铁票价贵一点，但是速度很快，节省时间。
高铁.en: Although high-speed rail tickets are a bit expensive, the speed is fast and saves time.
The high-speed rail is very quiet.

课文.en: This lesson text is very difficult.

课文.zh: 老师让我们回家把课文读三遍。
课文.en: The teacher asked us to read the lesson text three times at home.

课文.zh: 课文的生词我还没记住。
课文.en: I haven't memorized the new words in the lesson text yet.

课文.zh: 因为课文内容很有趣，所以我们都读得很认真。
课文.en: Because the lesson content is very interesting, we all read it very attentively.
There are grammar points in the lesson text.

衣架.zh: 请把衣服挂在衣架上，不要乱放。
衣架.en: Please hang the clothes on the hanger, don't leave them lying around.

衣架.zh: 我在超市买了十个新衣架。
衣架.en: I bought ten new clothes hangers at the supermarket.

衣架.zh: 因为衣架不够用，所以我又买了一些。
衣架.en: Because I didn't have enough hangers, I bought some more.
The hangers are hanging in the wardrobe.

外文.en: He is reading a foreign language book.

外文.zh: 这家书店有很多外文杂志和小说。
外文.en: This bookstore has many foreign language magazines and novels.

外文.zh: 我外文不太好，需要查字典。
外文.en: My foreign language skills are not great, I need to look up the dictionary.

外文.zh: 虽然他外文水平不高，但他还是坚持读原版小说。
外文.en: Although his foreign language level is not high, he still insists on reading original novels.
This document is in a foreign language.

空儿.en: I'll look for you when I have free time.

空儿.zh: 这个周末我没什么空儿。
空儿.en: I don't have much free time this weekend.

空儿.zh: 你要是明天有空儿，我们就去看电影。
空儿.en: If you have free time tomorrow, we'll go see a movie.

空儿.zh: 他忙得连一点空儿都没有。
空儿.en: He is so busy that he doesn't have even a bit of free time.

后年.en: I will graduate the year after next.
They plan to get married the year after next.

后年.zh: 后年我弟弟该上小学了。
后年.en: My younger brother will start primary school the year after next.

后年.zh: 如果后年房价降了，我就买房。
后年.en: If the housing price drops the year after next, I'll buy a house.

后年.zh: 现在先存钱，后年去旅行。
后年.en: Save money now, and travel the year after next.

聊天儿.zh: 吃完饭后，我们一边喝茶一边聊天儿。
聊天儿.en: After dinner, we chatted while drinking tea.

聊天儿.zh: 别在上班的时候聊天儿。
我跟他聊天儿聊了两个小时。
聊天儿.en: I chatted with him for two hours.

红酒.en: This bottle of red wine is good.
She drank a small glass of red wine.

红酒.zh: 吃牛排的时候，我喜欢配红酒。
红酒.en: I like to pair red wine with steak.

红酒.zh: 虽然红酒很贵，但味道确实好。
红酒.en: Although red wine is expensive, it tastes really good.

红酒.zh: 他买了两瓶法国红酒送朋友。
红酒.en: He bought two bottles of French red wine as gifts for friends.

银行卡.en: I forgot to bring my bank card.
Please pay with a bank card.

银行卡.zh: 你的银行卡密码是多少？
银行卡.en: What is your bank card PIN?

银行卡.zh: 如果没现金，可以刷银行卡。
银行卡.en: If you don't have cash, you can swipe a bank card.

银行卡.zh: 他丢了一张银行卡，正在挂失。
银行卡.en: He lost a bank card and is reporting the loss.
